**Oui, tout à fait !** Je peux créer le code, l'architecture et même générer des objets 3D/interfaces qui se synchronisent **en direct dans ton Roblox Studio** pendant qu'on travaille ensemble.

Comme je fonctionne depuis ton ordinateur (via des fichiers et des commandes), voici les **3 méthodes** qu'on peut utiliser pour que je construise le jeu directement dans ton Roblox Studio :

---

### 1. La méthode Pro en temps réel : **Rojo** (Recommandé)
C'est l'outil standard utilisé par les développeurs Roblox professionnels :
- Je crée le projet sur ton PC et je lance un serveur **Rojo** en arrière-plan.
- De ton côté, tu installes simplement le plugin **Rojo** dans Roblox Studio et tu cliques sur **"Connect"**.
- **Résultat :** Dès que j'écris un script (`ServerScriptService`, `StarterGui`, `ReplicatedStorage`, etc.) ou que je crée des éléments, ils apparaissent **instantanément** dans ton Roblox Studio en temps réel.

### 2. La génération directe de fichier `.rbxlx` (Zéro installation)
- Les places Roblox peuvent être sauvegardées au format `.rbxlx` (qui est un fichier XML lisible et modifiable).
- Je peux générer ou modifier directement ce fichier sur ton PC : il te suffit de double-cliquer dessus pour l'ouvrir dans Roblox Studio avec tous les scripts, la map de base, les dossiers et les interfaces déjà en place.

### 3. Un script / pont automatique (Command Bar ou Plugin local)
- Si tu veux aussi que je génère des bâtiments, des maps 3D procédurales, des lumières ou des modèles directement dans le `Workspace`, je peux créer un petit script local qui construit toute la scène 3D automatiquement dans Studio.

---

### Par quoi veux-tu commencer ?
Dis-moi :
1. **Quelle méthode préfères-tu ?** (Je peux vérifier et installer *Rojo* pour toi, ou créer directement un fichier `.rbxlx` prêt à ouvrir).
2. **Quel est le concept de ton jeu ?** (Tycoon, Obby, Simulator, RPG, jeu d'horreur, PvP, etc. — donne-moi toutes tes instructions !)

		GuardianSpeed = 29,
		GuardianAggroRange = 55,
		GuardianColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 70),
		GuardianScale = 1.95,
		DropTable = {
			FrostbiteBlade = 20,
			SolarExcalibur = 30,
			MagmaReaper = 25,
			Voidbreaker = 18,
			CelestialArchblade = 7,
		},
	},
}

GameConfig.Upgrades = {

	},
	CarryStrength = {

	ForgeSpeed = {

		BaseCost = 400,
		CostMultiplier = 3.5,
		MaxLevel = 4, -- Commence au niveau 1
	},
}

function GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(upgradeId: string, currentLevel: number): number
	local upg = GameConfig.Upgrades[upgradeId]
	if not upg then
		return 999999
	end
	return math.floor(upg.BaseCost * (upg.CostMultiplier ^ (currentLevel - 1)))
end

function GameConfig.RollSwordFromStone(stoneId: string): string
	for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
		if tier.Id == stoneId then
			local totalWeight = 0
			for _, weight in pairs(tier.DropTable) do
				totalWeight += weight
			end
			local roll = math.random() * totalWeight
			local cumulative = 0
			for swordId, weight in pairs(tier.DropTable) do
				cumulative += weight
				if roll <= cumulative then
					return swordId
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return "RustySword"
end

return GameConfig

--!strict
-- Générateur de modèles 3D procéduraux (Pierres d'Épée style Excalibur, Épées 3D, Enclumes, Gardiens)

local GameConfig = require(script.Parent.GameConfig)

local ModelBuilder = {}

local function createPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = if props.Anchored ~= nil then props.Anchored else true
	p.CanCollide = if props.CanCollide ~= nil then props.CanCollide else false
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.Name then
		p.Name = props.Name
	end
	if props.Parent then
		p.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return p
end

local function weldParts(root: BasePart, part: BasePart)
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Part0 = root
	w.Part1 = part
	w.Parent = root
end

-- Crée une Pierre d'Épée (Rocher mystique avec une épée scellée plantée dedans)
function ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier, cframe: CFrame, isCarried: boolean?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = stoneTier.Name

	local anchored = not isCarried

	local baseRock = createPart({
		Name = "PrimaryPart",
		Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 2.2, 3.2),
		Color = stoneTier.StoneColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Slate,
		CFrame = cframe,
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = not isCarried,
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = baseRock

	-- Cristaux lumineux incrustés dans le rocher
	local crystalOffsets = {
		CFrame.new(1.1, 0.4, 0.8) * CFrame.Angles(0.3, 0.2, -0.4),
		CFrame.new(-1.1, 0.3, -0.7) * CFrame.Angles(-0.2, 0.5, 0.3),
		CFrame.new(0.6, 0.5, -1.0) * CFrame.Angles(0.4, -0.3, 0.2),
	}
	for i, offset in ipairs(crystalOffsets) do
		local crystal = createPart({
			Name = "Crystal" .. i,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.55, 1.6, 0.55),
			Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			CFrame = cframe * offset,
			Anchored = anchored,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = model,
		})
		if not anchored then
			weldParts(baseRock, crystal)
		end
	end

	-- Lame scellée plantée au sommet du rocher (Style Excalibur)
	local sealedBlade = createPart({
		Name = "SealedBlade",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 3.4, 0.85),
		Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 2.0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(8)),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	if not anchored then
		weldParts(baseRock, sealedBlade)
	end

	local crossGuard = createPart({
		Name = "CrossGuard",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.35, 2.1),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		CFrame = sealedBlade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.1, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	if not anchored then
		weldParts(baseRock, crossGuard)
	end

	local grip = createPart({
		Name = "Grip",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.32, 1.1, 0.35),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 55, 35),
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CFrame = sealedBlade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.75, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	if not anchored then
		weldParts(baseRock, grip)
	end

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor
	light.Range = 12
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Parent = sealedBlade

	return model
end

-- Crée un modèle d'Épée 3D (pour les piédestaux de la base ou dans la main du joueur)
function ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(swordId: string, cframe: CFrame, anchored: boolean): Model
	local info = GameConfig.Swords[swordId] or GameConfig.Swords.RustySword
	local rarity = GameConfig.Rarities[info.Rarity] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common
	local scale = info.Scale or 1.0

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = info.Name

	local handle = createPart({
		Name = "Handle",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 1.3 * scale, 0.35),
		Color = info.HandleColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		CFrame = cframe,
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = handle

	local guard = createPart({
		Name = "Guard",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.45 * scale, 0.35 * scale, 2.0 * scale),
		Color = rarity.Color,
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 0.7 * scale, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local bladeLength = 3.8 * scale
	local blade = createPart({
		Name = "Blade",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.18 * scale, bladeLength, 0.75 * scale),
		Color = info.BladeColor,
		Material = if rarity.Order >= 3 then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.Metal,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 0.7 * scale + bladeLength / 2, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local coreGlow = createPart({
		Name = "CoreGlow",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.22 * scale, bladeLength * 0.85, 0.25 * scale),
		Color = info.GlowColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame,
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local pommel = createPart({
		Name = "Pommel",
		Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
		Size = Vector3.new(0.55 * scale, 0.55 * scale, 0.55 * scale),
		Color = rarity.Color,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, -0.75 * scale, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	if not anchored then
		weldParts(handle, guard)
		weldParts(handle, blade)
		weldParts(handle, coreGlow)
		weldParts(handle, pommel)
	end

	if rarity.Order >= 3 then
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = rarity.Color
		light.Range = 8 + rarity.Order * 2
		light.Brightness = 1.8
		light.Parent = blade

		local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color, info.GlowColor)
		particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.25 * scale),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
		particles.Rate = 6 * rarity.Order
		particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5, 3.5)
		particles.LightEmission = 1
		particles.Parent = blade
	end

	return model
end

-- Crée un Gardien de Zone
function ModelBuilder.CreateGuardianModel(stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier, spawnPos: Vector3): Model
	local s = stoneTier.GuardianScale
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = stoneTier.GuardianName

	local torso = createPart({
		Name = "HumanoidRootPart",
		Size = Vector3.new(3.2 * s, 4.2 * s, 2.0 * s),
		Color = stoneTier.GuardianColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Slate,
		CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnPos + Vector3.new(0, 2.5 * s, 0)),
		Anchored = true,
		CanCollide = true,
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = torso

	local head = createPart({
		Name = "Head",
		Size = Vector3.new(2.0 * s, 2.0 * s, 2.0 * s),
		Color = stoneTier.GuardianColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Slate,
		CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.1 * s, 0),
		Anchored = true,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	-- Yeux ardents du gardien
	for _, side in ipairs({ -0.45, 0.45 }) do
		createPart({
			Name = "Eye",
			Size = Vector3.new(0.45 * s, 0.25 * s, 0.2 * s),
			Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(side * s, 0.2 * s, -0.95 * s),
			Anchored = true,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = model,
		})
	end

	-- Coeur runique lumineux
	createPart({
		Name = "RuneCore",
		Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
		Size = Vector3.new(1.4 * s, 1.4 * s, 1.4 * s),
		Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.4 * s, -0.6 * s),
		Anchored = true,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	-- Billboard d'information au-dessus du gardien
	local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bg.Name = "GuardianTag"
	bg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 55)
	bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.8 * s, 0)
	bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bg.MaxDistance = 120
	bg.Parent = head

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.55)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "⚔️ " .. stoneTier.GuardianName
	title.TextColor3 = stoneTier.CrystalColor
	title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	title.TextScaled = true
	title.Parent = bg

	local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	status.Name = "Status"
	status.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.55)
	status.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.45)
	status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	status.Text = "Patrouille..."
	status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
	status.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	status.TextScaled = true
	status.Parent = bg

	return model
end

return ModelBuilder

--!strict
-- Serveur principal de "Voler une Épée" (Steal a Sword)
-- Gère : génération de la Map, Bases des joueurs, Enclumes de forge, Socles d'épées,
-- Apparition des Pierres d'Épée, IA des Gardiens, Économie et Améliorations.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local GameConfig = require(Shared:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local ModelBuilder = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ModelBuilder"))

-- Création des RemoteEvents pour communiquer avec l'interface joueur
local Remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
Remotes.Name = "Remotes"
Remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local StateUpdateEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
StateUpdateEvent.Name = "StateUpdate"
StateUpdateEvent.Parent = Remotes

local NotificationEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
NotificationEvent.Name = "Notification"
NotificationEvent.Parent = Remotes

local SwordRevealEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
SwordRevealEvent.Name = "SwordReveal"
SwordRevealEvent.Parent = Remotes

local ActionEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
ActionEvent.Name = "PlayerAction"
ActionEvent.Parent = Remotes

-- Dossier principal du monde
local MapFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("StealASwordMap")
if MapFolder then
	MapFolder:Destroy()
end
MapFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
MapFolder.Name = "StealASwordMap"
MapFolder.Parent = Workspace

-- Nettoyage de la Baseplate par défaut si présente pour construire notre monde sur mesure
local defaultBaseplate = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
if defaultBaseplate and defaultBaseplate:IsA("BasePart") then
	defaultBaseplate.Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 135, 75)
	defaultBaseplate.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
	defaultBaseplate.Size = Vector3.new(600, 8, 600)
	defaultBaseplate.Position = Vector3.new(0, -4, 0)
end

-- Types de données joueur
type AnvilSlot = {
	SlotIndex: number,
	StoneId: string?,
	EndTime: number?,
	Part: Part,
	BillboardLabel: TextLabel,
	Prompt: ProximityPrompt,
	VisualModel: Model?,
}

type PedestalSlot = {
	SlotIndex: number,
	SwordId: string?,
	Part: Part,
	BillboardLabel: TextLabel,
	VisualModel: Model?,
}

type PlayerSession = {
	Player: Player,
	Gold: number,
	CarryingStoneId: string?,
	CarriedModel: Model?,
	EquippedSwordId: string?,
	EquippedToolModel: Model?,
	Inventory: { string }, -- Liste des SwordId possédées
	Upgrades: {
		SpeedLevel: number,
		CarryStrength: number,
		ForgeSpeed: number,
		AnvilCount: number,
	},
	BaseIndex: number,
	BaseModel: Model,
	SpawnCFrame: CFrame,
	Anvils: { AnvilSlot },
	Pedestals: { PedestalSlot },
	LastDashTime: number,
}

local PlayerSessions: { [Player]: PlayerSession } = {}
local AssignedBases: { [number]: Player? } = {}

-- Utilitaire de création de Part
local function createPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = if props.Anchored ~= nil then props.Anchored else true
	p.CanCollide = if props.CanCollide ~= nil then props.CanCollide else true
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Name then
		p.Name = props.Name
	end
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	if props.Parent then
		p.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return p
end

local function createBillboardText(parent: Instance, text: string, color: Color3, offset: Vector3, size: UDim2?): TextLabel
	local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bg.Size = size or UDim2.fromOffset(200, 50)
	bg.StudsOffset = offset
	bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bg.MaxDistance = 110
	bg.Parent = parent

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Text = text
	lbl.TextColor3 = color
	lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	lbl.TextScaled = true
	lbl.Parent = bg
	return lbl
end

-- Calcule le revenu d'or par seconde d'un joueur selon ses piédestaux
local function getPlayerGoldPerSec(session: PlayerSession): number
	local total = 0
	for _, ped in ipairs(session.Pedestals) do
		if ped.SwordId then
			local sword = GameConfig.Swords[ped.SwordId]
			if sword then
				total += sword.GoldPerSec
			end
		end
	end
	return total
end

-- Met à jour la vitesse du joueur (WalkSpeed) selon son épée équipée, ses bottes, et s'il porte une pierre
local function updatePlayerSpeed(session: PlayerSession)
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then
		return
	end

	local baseSpeed = 16 + (session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel - 1) * 2
	if session.EquippedSwordId then
		local sword = GameConfig.Swords[session.EquippedSwordId]
		if sword then
			baseSpeed += sword.SpeedBonus
		end
	end

	if session.CarryingStoneId then
		local slowFactor = 0.7
		for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
			if tier.Id == session.CarryingStoneId then
				slowFactor = tier.CarrySlowFactor
				break
			end
		end
		-- L'amélioration Force de Forgeron réduit la pénalité de poids
		local penaltyReduction = (session.Upgrades.CarryStrength - 1) * 0.04
		local finalFactor = math.clamp(slowFactor + penaltyReduction, 0.45, 0.95)
		baseSpeed = math.max(10, baseSpeed * finalFactor)
	end

	hum.WalkSpeed = baseSpeed
end

-- Envoie l'état complet du joueur au Client (UI)
local function syncPlayerState(session: PlayerSession)
	local leaderstats = session.Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		local goldVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Or") :: IntValue?
		if goldVal then
			goldVal.Value = math.floor(session.Gold)
		end
		local swordsVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Épées") :: IntValue?
		if swordsVal then
			swordsVal.Value = #session.Inventory
		end
	end

	StateUpdateEvent:FireClient(session.Player, {
		Gold = math.floor(session.Gold),
		GoldPerSec = getPlayerGoldPerSec(session),
		CarryingStoneId = session.CarryingStoneId,
		EquippedSwordId = session.EquippedSwordId,
		Inventory = session.Inventory,
		Upgrades = session.Upgrades,
	})
end

-- Place automatiquement les meilleures épées du joueur sur les piédestaux de sa base
local function refreshBasePedestals(session: PlayerSession)
	-- Trier l'inventaire par GoldPerSec décroissant
	local sorted = table.clone(session.Inventory)
	table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
		local sa = GameConfig.Swords[a]
		local sb = GameConfig.Swords[b]
		local ga = if sa then sa.GoldPerSec else 0
		local gb = if sb then sb.GoldPerSec else 0
		return ga > gb
	end)

	for i, ped in ipairs(session.Pedestals) do
		if ped.VisualModel then
			ped.VisualModel:Destroy()
			ped.VisualModel = nil
		end
		local swordId = sorted[i]
		ped.SwordId = swordId
		if swordId then
			local info = GameConfig.Swords[swordId]
			local rarity = GameConfig.Rarities[info.Rarity]
			local swordModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(
				swordId,
				ped.Part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(i * 45), math.rad(180)),
				true
			)
			swordModel.Parent = session.BaseModel
			ped.VisualModel = swordModel
			ped.BillboardLabel.Text = string.format("%s\n[%s] +%d Or/s", info.Name, rarity.Name, info.GoldPerSec)
			ped.BillboardLabel.TextColor3 = rarity.Color
		else
			ped.BillboardLabel.Text = "Socle d'Épée Vide"
			ped.BillboardLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 175)
		end
	end
end

-- Équipe visuellement la meilleure épée dans la main du joueur
local function equipSwordOnCharacter(session: PlayerSession, swordId: string)
	session.EquippedSwordId = swordId
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	if session.EquippedToolModel then
		session.EquippedToolModel:Destroy()
		session.EquippedToolModel = nil
	end

	local hand = (char:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) :: BasePart?
	if not hand then
		return
	end

	local swordModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(
		swordId,
		hand.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.5, -1.2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0),
		false
	)
	swordModel.Name = "EquippedSwordVisual"
	swordModel.Parent = char

	if swordModel.PrimaryPart then
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = hand
		weld.Part1 = swordModel.PrimaryPart
		weld.Parent = swordModel.PrimaryPart
	end

	session.EquippedToolModel = swordModel
	updatePlayerSpeed(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

-- Retire la Pierre d'Épée portée par le joueur (ex: déposée sur une enclume ou confisquée par un gardien)
local function clearCarriedStone(session: PlayerSession)
	session.CarryingStoneId = nil
	if session.CarriedModel then
		session.CarriedModel:Destroy()
		session.CarriedModel = nil
	end
	updatePlayerSpeed(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

-- Attache une Pierre d'Épée volée au-dessus de la tête/dos du joueur
local function giveCarriedStone(session: PlayerSession, stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier)
	clearCarriedStone(session)
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not hrp then
		return
	end

	session.CarryingStoneId = stoneTier.Id
	local stoneModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(stoneTier, hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.8, 0), true)
	stoneModel.Name = "CarriedSwordStone"
	stoneModel.Parent = char

	if stoneModel.PrimaryPart then
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = hrp
		weld.Part1 = stoneModel.PrimaryPart
		weld.Parent = stoneModel.PrimaryPart
	end

	createBillboardText(
		stoneModel.PrimaryPart,
		"🪨 " .. stoneTier.Name .. "\n(Ramène-la à ton Enclume !)",
		stoneTier.CrystalColor,
		Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0),
		UDim2.fromOffset(240, 55)
	)

	session.CarriedModel = stoneModel
	updatePlayerSpeed(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

-- Met à jour l'affichage des enclumes débloquées/verrouillées dans la base du joueur
local function refreshAnvilLocks(session: PlayerSession)
	for _, anvil in ipairs(session.Anvils) do
		local unlocked = anvil.SlotIndex <= session.Upgrades.AnvilCount
		if unlocked then
			anvil.Part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85)
			anvil.Prompt.Enabled = true
			if not anvil.StoneId then
				anvil.BillboardLabel.Text = string.format("🔨 Enclume #%d\nPrête à forger", anvil.SlotIndex)
				anvil.BillboardLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
			end
		else
			anvil.Part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 50)
			anvil.Prompt.Enabled = false
			anvil.BillboardLabel.Text = string.format("🔒 Enclume #%d\n(Débloquer en Boutique)", anvil.SlotIndex)
			anvil.BillboardLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 150)
		end
	end
end

-- Gestion de l'interaction avec une Enclume (Poser une pierre OU Réclamer l'épée forgée)
local function onAnvilInteract(session: PlayerSession, anvil: AnvilSlot)
	if anvil.SlotIndex > session.Upgrades.AnvilCount then
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(session.Player, "Achète l'amélioration 'Enclume Supplémentaire' dans la boutique !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 80))
		return
	end

	-- Cas 1 : L'enclume est vide et le joueur porte une Pierre d'Épée
	if not anvil.StoneId then
		if not session.CarryingStoneId then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				session.Player,
				"Tu ne portes aucune Pierre d'Épée ! Va en voler une dans les zones des Gardiens !",
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60)
			)
			return
		end

		local stoneId = session.CarryingStoneId
		local foundTier: GameConfig.StoneTier? = nil
		for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
			if tier.Id == stoneId then
				foundTier = tier
				break
			end
		end
		if not foundTier then
			return
		end

		clearCarriedStone(session)

		-- Calcul du temps de forge avec le bonus Marteau Enflammé
		local speedMultiplier = 1 + (session.Upgrades.ForgeSpeed - 1) * 0.12
		local duration = math.max(3, math.ceil(foundTier.ForgeTime / speedMultiplier))

		anvil.StoneId = stoneId
		anvil.EndTime = os.clock() + duration
		anvil.Prompt.ActionText = "Forgeage en cours..."

		local stoneVisual = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(foundTier, anvil.Part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 0), false)
		stoneVisual.Parent = session.BaseModel
		anvil.VisualModel = stoneVisual

		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			string.format("🔥 %s posée sur l'Enclume ! Forgeage : %ds", foundTier.Name, duration),
			foundTier.CrystalColor
		)
		return
	end

	-- Cas 2 : Une pierre est sur l'enclume
	local now = os.clock()
	if anvil.EndTime and now < anvil.EndTime then
		local remaining = math.ceil(anvil.EndTime - now)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			string.format("⏳ Patiente encore %d seconde(s) pour que la lame soit forgée !", remaining),
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 90)
		)
		return
	end

	-- Cas 3 : Le forgeage est terminé -> Révélation de l'épée !
	local forgedStoneId = anvil.StoneId
	anvil.StoneId = nil
	anvil.EndTime = nil
	if anvil.VisualModel then
		anvil.VisualModel:Destroy()
		anvil.VisualModel = nil
	end
	anvil.Prompt.ActionText = "Déposer Pierre / Réclamer"
	anvil.BillboardLabel.Text = string.format("🔨 Enclume #%d\nPrête à forger", anvil.SlotIndex)
	anvil.BillboardLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)

	local wonSwordId = GameConfig.RollSwordFromStone(forgedStoneId :: string)
	local swordInfo = GameConfig.Swords[wonSwordId]
	local rarityInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[swordInfo.Rarity]

	table.insert(session.Inventory, wonSwordId)

	-- Équiper automatiquement si c'est une meilleure épée que celle équipée
	local currentBestSpeed = 0
	if session.EquippedSwordId and GameConfig.Swords[session.EquippedSwordId] then
		currentBestSpeed = GameConfig.Swords[session.EquippedSwordId].SpeedBonus
	end
	if swordInfo.SpeedBonus >= currentBestSpeed then
		equipSwordOnCharacter(session, wonSwordId)
	end

	refreshBasePedestals(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)

	-- Envoyer l'animation d'ouverture au joueur
	SwordRevealEvent:FireClient(session.Player, {
		SwordId = wonSwordId,
		Name = swordInfo.Name,
		Rarity = rarityInfo.Name,
		RarityColor = rarityInfo.Color,
		GoldPerSec = swordInfo.GoldPerSec,
		SpeedBonus = swordInfo.SpeedBonus,
	})

	-- Annonce globale si l'épée est Légendaire, Mythique ou Divine !
	if rarityInfo.Order >= 4 then
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				p,
				string.format("🌟 %s vient de forger [%s] %s (+%d Or/s) !", session.Player.DisplayName, rarityInfo.Name, swordInfo.Name, swordInfo.GoldPerSec),
				rarityInfo.Color
			)
		end
	end
end

-- Construction d'un emplacement de Base (Forge personnelle) pour un joueur
local function buildPlayerBaseSlot(baseIndex: number, centerPos: Vector3): (Model, CFrame, { AnvilSlot }, { PedestalSlot }, TextLabel)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "PlayerForgeBase_" .. baseIndex
	model.Parent = MapFolder

	-- Sol de la Forge (Zone de sécurité)
	local floor = createPart({
		Name = "SafeZoneFloor",
		Size = Vector3.new(46, 1.5, 42),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 65, 78),
		Material = Enum.Material.Cobblestone,
		Parent = model,
	})

	-- Bordure lumineuse dorée indiquant la Zone Sûre
	createPart({
		Name = "SafeBorderFront",
		Size = Vector3.new(46, 0.6, 1.2),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, -20.4)),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 225, 130),
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		Parent = model,
	})

	-- Arche d'entrée de la Forge
	local leftPillar = createPart({
		Size = Vector3.new(3, 14, 3),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(-14, 7, -19)),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 105),
		Material = Enum.Material.Brick,
		Parent = model,
	})
	createPart({
		Size = Vector3.new(3, 14, 3),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(14, 7, -19)),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 105),
		Material = Enum.Material.Brick,
		Parent = model,
	})
	local signBanner = createPart({
		Size = Vector3.new(31, 3.2, 1.8),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(0, 15, -19)),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 45, 58),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		Parent = model,
	})
	local ownerLabel = createBillboardText(
		signBanner,
		"🏰 Forge Libre #" .. baseIndex,
		Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90),
		Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0),
		UDim2.fromOffset(280, 60)
	)
	local _ = leftPillar

	-- Création des 4 Enclumes de Forge (à gauche de la base)
	local anvils: { AnvilSlot } = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local zOffset = -10 + (i - 1) * 7.5
		local anvilBase = createPart({
			Name = "Anvil_" .. i,
			Size = Vector3.new(4.2, 2.8, 2.8),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(-15, 2.1, zOffset)),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85),
			Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
			Parent = model,
		})

		-- Dépôt automatique quand on marche près de l'enclume OU avec ProximityPrompt (touche E)
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ObjectText = "Enclume de Forge #" .. i
		prompt.ActionText = "Poser Pierre / Réclamer Épée"
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
		prompt.Parent = anvilBase

		local lbl = createBillboardText(
			anvilBase,
			"🔨 Enclume #" .. i,
			Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245),
			Vector3.new(0, 3.8, 0),
			UDim2.fromOffset(190, 50)
		)

		local slot: AnvilSlot = {
			SlotIndex = i,
			StoneId = nil,
			EndTime = nil,
			Part = anvilBase,
			BillboardLabel = lbl,
			Prompt = prompt,
			VisualModel = nil,
		}

		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(triggerPlayer: Player)
			local sess = PlayerSessions[triggerPlayer]
			if sess and sess.BaseIndex == baseIndex then
				onAnvilInteract(sess, slot)
			else
				NotificationEvent:FireClient(triggerPlayer, "Ce n'est pas ta Forge !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90))
			end
		end)

		-- Permet aussi de simplement toucher l'enclume pour poser ou récupérer rapidement !
		local debounce = false
		anvilBase.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
			if debounce then
				return
			end
			local char = hit.Parent
			if not char then
				return
			end
			local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
			if not plr then
				return
			end
			local sess = PlayerSessions[plr]
			if sess and sess.BaseIndex == baseIndex then
				if (not slot.StoneId and sess.CarryingStoneId) or (slot.StoneId and slot.EndTime and os.clock() >= slot.EndTime) then
					debounce = true
					onAnvilInteract(sess, slot)
					task.delay(0.8, function()
						debounce = false
					end)
				end
			end
		end)

		table.insert(anvils, slot)
	end

	-- Création des 6 Socles / Piédestaux d'exposition d'épées (à droite et au fond de la base)
	local pedestals: { PedestalSlot } = {}
	local pedestalOffsets = {
		Vector3.new(15, 2.0, -10),
		Vector3.new(15, 2.0, -2.5),
		Vector3.new(15, 2.0, 5.0),
		Vector3.new(15, 2.0, 12.5),
		Vector3.new(5, 2.0, 14),
		Vector3.new(-5, 2.0, 14),
	}
	for i, offset in ipairs(pedestalOffsets) do
		local pedPart = createPart({
			Name = "Pedestal_" .. i,
			Size = Vector3.new(3.5, 2.6, 3.5),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + offset),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(215, 180, 85),
			Material = Enum.Material.Marble,
			Parent = model,
		})
		local lbl = createBillboardText(
			pedPart,
			"Socle d'Épée Vide",
			Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 175),
			Vector3.new(0, 6.2, 0),
			UDim2.fromOffset(185, 48)
		)
		table.insert(pedestals, {
			SlotIndex = i,
			SwordId = nil,
			Part = pedPart,
			BillboardLabel = lbl,
			VisualModel = nil,
		})
	end

	local spawnCF = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(0, 4, -5), centerPos + Vector3.new(0, 4, -50))
	local _ = floor
	return model, spawnCF, anvils, pedestals, ownerLabel
end

-- Construction des 4 Zones Dangereuses (Nids de Pierres d'Épée + Gardiens) du Sud vers le Nord
type ActiveStoneSpawn = {
	Tier: GameConfig.StoneTier,
	SpawnPos: Vector3,
	CurrentModel: Model?,
	RespawnAt: number?,
}

type ActiveGuardian = {
	Tier: GameConfig.StoneTier,
	Model: Model,
	HomePos: Vector3,
	PatrolAngle: number,
	StatusLabel: TextLabel?,
}

local StoneSpawns: { ActiveStoneSpawn } = {}
local Guardians: { ActiveGuardian } = {}

local function spawnSwordStoneAt(slot: ActiveStoneSpawn)
	if slot.CurrentModel then
		slot.CurrentModel:Destroy()
		slot.CurrentModel = nil
	end

	local model = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(slot.Tier, CFrame.new(slot.SpawnPos), false)
	model.Parent = MapFolder
	slot.CurrentModel = model

	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then
		return
	end

	createBillboardText(
		root,
		string.format("⚔️ %s\n(Forge : %ds)", slot.Tier.Name, slot.Tier.ForgeTime),
		slot.Tier.CrystalColor,
		Vector3.new(0, 4.8, 0),
		UDim2.fromOffset(210, 50)
	)

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ObjectText = slot.Tier.ZoneName
	prompt.ActionText = "Voler la " .. slot.Tier.Name
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.25
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 11
	prompt.Parent = root

	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(plr: Player)
		local sess = PlayerSessions[plr]
		if not sess then
			return
		end
		if sess.CarryingStoneId then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				plr,
				"Tu portes déjà une Pierre d'Épée ! Ramène-la d'abord à ton Enclume !",
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 60)
			)
			return
		end
		if not slot.CurrentModel then
			return
		end

		-- Voler la pierre !
		slot.CurrentModel:Destroy()
		slot.CurrentModel = nil
		slot.RespawnAt = os.clock() + 8

		giveCarriedStone(sess, slot.Tier)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			plr,
			string.format("⚠️ Tu as dérobé une %s ! Fuis les %ss jusqu'à ta Forge !", slot.Tier.Name, slot.Tier.GuardianName),
			slot.Tier.CrystalColor
		)
	end)
end

-- Gestion de la connexion d'un joueur
local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	-- Attribution d'une base libre
	local chosenIndex = 1
	for i = 1, 4 do
		if not AssignedBases[i] then
			chosenIndex = i
			AssignedBases[i] = player
			break
		end
	end

	local baseSlot = BaseSlotsData[chosenIndex]
	baseSlot.OwnerLabel.Text = "🏰 Forge de " .. player.DisplayName

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local goldVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
	goldVal.Name = "Or"
	goldVal.Value = 25
	goldVal.Parent = leaderstats

	local swordsVal = Instance.new("IntValue")
	swordsVal.Name = "Épées"
	swordsVal.Value = 0
	swordsVal.Parent = leaderstats

	local session: PlayerSession = {
		Player = player,
		Gold = 25,
		CarryingStoneId = nil,
		CarriedModel = nil,
		EquippedSwordId = nil,
		EquippedToolModel = nil,
		Inventory = {},
		Upgrades = {
			SpeedLevel = 1,
			CarryStrength = 1,
			ForgeSpeed = 1,
			AnvilCount = 1,
		},
		BaseIndex = chosenIndex,
		BaseModel = baseSlot.Model,
		SpawnCFrame = baseSlot.SpawnCFrame,
		Anvils = baseSlot.Anvils,
		Pedestals = baseSlot.Pedestals,
		LastDashTime = 0,
	}
	PlayerSessions[player] = session

	refreshAnvilLocks(session)
	refreshBasePedestals(session)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char: Model)
		task.wait(0.15)
		local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5) :: BasePart?
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = session.SpawnCFrame
		end
		session.CarryingStoneId = nil
		session.CarriedModel = nil
		if session.EquippedSwordId then
			equipSwordOnCharacter(session, session.EquippedSwordId)
		else
			updatePlayerSpeed(session)
		end
		syncPlayerState(session)
	end)

	if player.Character then
		local hrp = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = session.SpawnCFrame
		end
	end

	task.delay(0.5, function()
		syncPlayerState(session)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			player,
			"⚔️ Bienvenue dans Voler une Épée ! Infiltre la Zone 1, vole une Pierre d'Épée et ramène-la sur ton Enclume !",
			Color3.fromRGB(110, 235, 255)
		)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local sess = PlayerSessions[player]
	if sess then
		AssignedBases[sess.BaseIndex] = nil
		local baseSlot = BaseSlotsData[sess.BaseIndex]
		if baseSlot then
			baseSlot.OwnerLabel.Text = "🏰 Forge Libre #" .. sess.BaseIndex
		end
		for _, anvil in ipairs(sess.Anvils) do
			anvil.StoneId = nil
			anvil.EndTime = nil
			if anvil.VisualModel then
				anvil.VisualModel:Destroy()
				anvil.VisualModel = nil
			end
		end
		for _, ped in ipairs(sess.Pedestals) do
			ped.SwordId = nil
			if ped.VisualModel then
				ped.VisualModel:Destroy()
				ped.VisualModel = nil
			end
		end
		PlayerSessions[player] = nil
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, plr)
end

-- Réception des actions du Client (Achat d'améliorations, Dash d'esquive, Équipement d'épée, Téléportation Base)
ActionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, actionType: string, payload: any)
	local sess = PlayerSessions[player]
	if not sess then
		return
	end

	if actionType == "BuyUpgrade" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		local upgConfig = GameConfig.Upgrades[payload]
		local currentLvl = (sess.Upgrades :: any)[payload]
		if not upgConfig or not currentLvl then
			return
		end
		if currentLvl >= upgConfig.MaxLevel then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "Niveau maximum déjà atteint !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 70))
			return
		end
		local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(payload, currentLvl)
		if sess.Gold < cost then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, string.format("Pas assez d'Or ! Il te faut %d Or.", cost), Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 95))
			return
		end

		sess.Gold -= cost
		;(sess.Upgrades :: any)[payload] = currentLvl + 1

		if payload == "AnvilCount" then
			refreshAnvilLocks(sess)
		end
		updatePlayerSpeed(sess)
		syncPlayerState(sess)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			player,
			string.format("✨ %s amélioré au Niveau %d !", upgConfig.Name, currentLvl + 1),
			Color3.fromRGB(95, 255, 140)
		)

	elseif actionType == "EquipSword" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		if table.find(sess.Inventory, payload) then
			equipSwordOnCharacter(sess, payload)
			local info = GameConfig.Swords[payload]
			if info then
				NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "⚔️ Épée équipée : " .. info.Name, Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255))
			end
		end

	elseif actionType == "Dash" then
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - sess.LastDashTime < 2.2 then
			return
		end
		sess.LastDashTime = now
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
		if hrp then
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 78 + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0)
		end

	elseif actionType == "TeleportBase" then
		if sess.CarryingStoneId then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				player,
				"⚠️ Impossible de se téléporter en portant une Pierre d'Épée ! Tu dois courir jusqu'à ta Forge !",
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 90)
			)
			return
		end
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = sess.SpawnCFrame
		end
	end
end)

-- Boucle 1 seconde : Revenu d'Or passif + Compte à rebours des Enclumes + Réapparition des Pierres
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local now = os.clock()

		-- Réapparition des Pierres d'Épée volées
		for _, slot in ipairs(StoneSpawns) do
			if not slot.CurrentModel and slot.RespawnAt and now >= slot.RespawnAt then
				slot.RespawnAt = nil
				spawnSwordStoneAt(slot)
			end
		end

		-- Mise à jour des joueurs et de leurs enclumes
		for _, sess in pairs(PlayerSessions) do
			local gps = getPlayerGoldPerSec(sess)
			if gps > 0 then
				sess.Gold += gps
			end

			for _, anvil in ipairs(sess.Anvils) do
				if anvil.StoneId and anvil.EndTime then
					local remaining = math.ceil(anvil.EndTime - now)
					if remaining > 0 then
						anvil.BillboardLabel.Text = string.format("🔥 Forgeage en cours...\n⏳ %ds", remaining)
						anvil.BillboardLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 65)
					else
						anvil.BillboardLabel.Text = "✨ ÉPÉE PRÊTE !\n[Touches E ou Marche dessus]"
						anvil.BillboardLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 255, 130)
						anvil.Prompt.ActionText = "Réclamer l'Épée Forgée !"
					end
				end
			end

			syncPlayerState(sess)
		end
	end
end)

-- Boucle IA des Gardiens (60 FPS) : Patrouille + Poursuite des voleurs de Pierres d'Épée !
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	for _, g in ipairs(Guardians) do
		local root = g.Model.PrimaryPart
		if not root then
			continue
		end

		-- Chercher le joueur le plus proche dans la zone (surtout s'il porte une Pierre d'Épée !)
		local targetPlayer: Player? = nil
		local targetPos: Vector3? = nil
		local bestDist = g.Tier.GuardianAggroRange

		for _, sess in pairs(PlayerSessions) do
			local char = sess.Player.Character
			local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
			if hrp then
				-- Si le joueur est dans la zone sûre (Z > 95), les gardiens ne peuvent pas l'attaquer
				if hrp.Position.Z < 95 then
					local dist = (hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					-- Les gardiens détectent de plus loin si le joueur porte une pierre !
					local effectiveRange = if sess.CarryingStoneId then g.Tier.GuardianAggroRange * 1.25 else g.Tier.GuardianAggroRange * 0.75
					if dist <= effectiveRange and dist < bestDist then
						bestDist = dist
						targetPlayer = sess.Player
						targetPos = hrp.Position
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local currentPos = root.Position
		local nextPos: Vector3
		local lookTarget: Vector3

		if targetPlayer and targetPos then
			-- Poursuite du voleur !
			if g.StatusLabel then
				g.StatusLabel.Text = "😡 POURSUITE : " .. targetPlayer.DisplayName .. " !"
				g.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85)
			end
			local dir = Vector3.new(targetPos.X - currentPos.X, 0, targetPos.Z - currentPos.Z)
			if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				nextPos = currentPos + dir.Unit * g.Tier.GuardianSpeed * dt
				lookTarget = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, currentPos.Y, targetPos.Z)
			else
				nextPos = currentPos
				lookTarget = currentPos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			-- Si le gardien attrape le joueur !
			if bestDist < 5.5 then
				local sess = PlayerSessions[targetPlayer]
				if sess then
					if sess.CarryingStoneId then
						clearCarriedStone(sess)
						NotificationEvent:FireClient(
							targetPlayer,
							string.format("💥 Attrappé par le %s ! Il a détruit ta Pierre d'Épée !", g.Tier.GuardianName),
							Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
						)
					else
						NotificationEvent:FireClient(
							targetPlayer,
							string.format("💥 Repoussé par le %s ! Utilise le Dash (Maj / Bouton) pour esquiver !", g.Tier.GuardianName),
							Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 75)
						)
					end
					-- Téléporter le joueur à sa base
					local char = targetPlayer.Character
					local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
					if hrp then
						hrp.CFrame = sess.SpawnCFrame
					end
				end
			end
		else
			-- Patrouille circulaire autour de son nid
			if g.StatusLabel then
				g.StatusLabel.Text = "Patrouille..."
				g.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235)
			end
			g.PatrolAngle += dt * 1.15
			local patrolTarget = g.HomePos + Vector3.new(math.cos(g.PatrolAngle) * 18, currentPos.Y - g.HomePos.Y, math.sin(g.PatrolAngle) * 10)
			local dir = Vector3.new(patrolTarget.X - currentPos.X, 0, patrolTarget.Z - currentPos.Z)
			if dir.Magnitude > 0.2 then
				nextPos = currentPos + dir.Unit * math.min(dir.Magnitude, g.Tier.GuardianSpeed * 0.65 * dt)
				lookTarget = Vector3.new(patrolTarget.X, currentPos.Y, patrolTarget.Z)
			else
				nextPos = currentPos
				lookTarget = currentPos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end
		end

		local deltaCF = CFrame.lookAt(nextPos, lookTarget) * root.CFrame:Inverse()
		for _, part in ipairs(g.Model:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CFrame = deltaCF * part.CFrame
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function showNotification(msg: string, color: Color3)
	local banner = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	banner.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
	banner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 32)
	banner.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15

	banner.TextScaled = true
	banner.Text = msg
	banner.Parent = notifContainer
	addCorner(banner, 8)
	addStroke(banner, color, 1.5)

	task.delay(4, function()
		local tw = TweenService:Create(banner, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1 })
		tw:Play()
		tw.Completed:Wait()

-- Rafraîchissement de l'UI selon l'état du joueur
local function refreshUI()
	goldLabel.Text = string.format("🪙 %d Or  (+%d Or/s)", currentState.Gold, currentState.GoldPerSec)

	if currentState.CarryingStoneId then
		local stoneName = currentState.CarryingStoneId
		for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
			if tier.Id == currentState.CarryingStoneId then
				stoneName = tier.Name
				break
			end
		end
		carryStatusLabel.Text = "🪨 Porte : " .. stoneName .. " -> Cours à ton Enclume !"
		carryStatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 195, 70)
	else
		carryStatusLabel.Text = "Mains libres — Infiltre une Zone et vole une Pierre d'Épée !"
		carryStatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 225, 255)
	end

	-- Mise à jour de la Boutique
	for _, upgId in ipairs(upgradeOrder) do
		local upgInfo = GameConfig.Upgrades[upgId]
		local ui = upgradeButtons[upgId]
		local lvl = (currentState.Upgrades :: any)[upgId] or 1
		ui.Label.Text = string.format("%s (Niv. %d/%d)\n%s", upgInfo.Name, lvl, upgInfo.MaxLevel, upgInfo.Description)
		if lvl >= upgInfo.MaxLevel then
			ui.Btn.Text = "MAX"
			ui.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(95, 100, 115)
		else
			local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(upgId, lvl)
			ui.Btn.Text = string.format("%d Or", cost)
			ui.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = if currentState.Gold >= cost
				then Color3.fromRGB(55, 190, 95)
				else Color3.fromRGB(145, 65, 65)
		end
	end

	-- Mise à jour de l'Inventaire d'Épées
	for _, child in ipairs(invList:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- Regrouper les épées par identifiant
	local counts: { [string]: number } = {}
	for _, sId in ipairs(currentState.Inventory) do
		counts[sId] = (counts[sId] or 0) + 1
	end

	local uniqueIds = {}
	for sId, _ in pairs(counts) do
		table.insert(uniqueIds, sId)
	end
	table.sort(uniqueIds, function(a, b)
		return GameConfig.Swords[a].GoldPerSec > GameConfig.Swords[b].GoldPerSec
	end)

	for _, sId in ipairs(uniqueIds) do
		local sInfo = GameConfig.Swords[sId]
		local rInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[sInfo.Rarity]
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 58)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 40, 56)
		row.Parent = invList
		addCorner(row, 10)
		addStroke(row, rInfo.Color, 1.5)

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.68, -10, 1, -8)
		lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		lbl.TextColor3 = rInfo.Color
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		lbl.TextScaled = true
		lbl.Text = string.format("[%s] %s (x%d)\n+%d Or/s  |  +%g Vitesse", rInfo.Name, sInfo.Name, counts[sId], sInfo.GoldPerSec, sInfo.SpeedBonus)
		lbl.Parent = row

		local eqBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		eqBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 40)
		eqBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.70, 0, 0.5, -20)
		local isEq = (currentState.EquippedSwordId == sId)
		eqBtn.BackgroundColor3 = if isEq then Color3.fromRGB(80, 175, 255) else Color3.fromRGB(70, 190, 100)
		eqBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		eqBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		eqBtn.TextScaled = true
		eqBtn.Text = if isEq then "Équipée" else "Équiper"
		eqBtn.Parent = row
		addCorner(eqBtn, 8)

		eqBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			ActionEvent:FireServer("EquipSword", sId)
		end)
	end

	invList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #uniqueIds * 68)
end

local lastDash = 0
local function triggerDash()
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - lastDash < 2.2 then

	end
	lastDash = now
	ActionEvent:FireServer("Dash")
	dashBtn.Text = "⏳ Recharge..."
	task.delay(2.2, function()
		dashBtn.Text = "💨 Dash [Q / Maj]"
	end)
end

dashBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(triggerDash)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
	if processed then

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
		triggerDash()
	end
end)

--!strict
-- Configuration centrale du jeu "Voler une Épée" (Style Steal an Egg)

local GameConfig = {}

export type RarityInfo = {
	Name: string,
	Color: Color3,
	Order: number,
}

export type SwordInfo = {
	Id: string,
	Name: string,
	Rarity: string,
	MoneyPerSec: number,
	BladeColor: Color3,
	HandleColor: Color3,
	GlowColor: Color3,
	Scale: number,
}

export type StoneTier = {
	Id: string,
	Name: string,
	ZoneName: string,
	ZoneOrder: number,
	ForgeTime: number, -- Temps en secondes
	CarrySlowFactor: number,
	FloorColor: Color3,
	WallColor: Color3,
	StoneColor: Color3,
	CrystalColor: Color3,
	GuardianName: string,
	GuardianSpeed: number,
	GuardianColor: Color3,
	GuardianScale: number,
	RecommendedSpeed: number,
	DropTable: { [string]: number },
}

-- Formatage des grands nombres ($1.2K, $5.4M, $1.2B, $53T) comme sur les captures d'écran
local SUFFIXES = { "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
function GameConfig.FormatNumber(n: number): string
	if n < 1000 then
		return tostring(math.floor(n))
	end
	local index = math.min(#SUFFIXES, math.floor(math.log10(n) / 3))
	local scaled = n / (10 ^ (index * 3))
	if scaled >= 100 then
		return string.format("%d%s", math.floor(scaled), SUFFIXES[index])
	else
		return string.format("%.1f%s", scaled, SUFFIXES[index]):gsub("%.0", "")
	end
end

-- Formatage du temps (ex: "45s", "4m 30s", "1h 15m")
function GameConfig.FormatTime(seconds: number): string
	seconds = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	if seconds < 60 then
		return string.format("%ds", seconds)
	elseif seconds < 3600 then
		local m = math.floor(seconds / 60)
		local s = seconds % 60
		if s == 0 then
			return string.format("%dm", m)
		end
		return string.format("%dm %ds", m, s)
	else
		local h = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
		local m = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
		return string.format("%dh %dm", h, m)
	end
end

function GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(upgradeId: string, currentLevel: number): number
	local upg = GameConfig.Upgrades[upgradeId]
	if not upg then
		return 999999
	end
	return math.floor(upg.BaseCost * (upg.CostMultiplier ^ (currentLevel - 1)))
end

function GameConfig.RollSwordFromStone(stoneId: string): string
	for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
		if tier.Id == stoneId then
			local totalWeight = 0
			for _, weight in pairs(tier.DropTable) do
				totalWeight += weight
			end
			local roll = math.random() * totalWeight
			local cumulative = 0
			for swordId, weight in pairs(tier.DropTable) do
				cumulative += weight
				if roll <= cumulative then
					return swordId
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return "WoodenDagger"
end

return GameConfig

--!strict
-- Générateur de modèles 3D (Pierres d'Épée aura lumineuse, Épées 3D, Gardiens, Clôtures, Tapis de course)

local GameConfig = require(script.Parent.GameConfig)

local ModelBuilder = {}

local function createPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = if props.Anchored ~= nil then props.Anchored else true
	p.CanCollide = if props.CanCollide ~= nil then props.CanCollide else false
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.Plastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	p.TopSurface = props.TopSurface or Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.Name then
		p.Name = props.Name
	end
	if props.Parent then
		p.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return p
end

local function weldParts(root: BasePart, part: BasePart)
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Part0 = root
	w.Part1 = part
	w.Parent = root
end

-- Crée une Pierre d'Épée cristalline façon "Oeuf / Rocher d'Aura" avec épée scellée à l'intérieur
function ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier, cframe: CFrame, isCarried: boolean?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = stoneTier.Name

	local anchored = not isCarried

	-- Coeur rocheux / cristal géant (forme ovoïde/cristalline comme sur l'image 1)
	local core = createPart({
		Name = "PrimaryPart",
		Size = Vector3.new(4.2, 5.0, 4.2),
		Color = stoneTier.StoneColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Slate,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = not isCarried,
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = core

	local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1.22, 1)
	mesh.Parent = core

	-- Éclats d'aura cristalline tout autour (style Oeuf / Pierre électrique de l'image 1)
	local shardAngles = { 0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300 }
	for i, deg in ipairs(shardAngles) do
		local rad = math.rad(deg)
		local offset = CFrame.new(math.cos(rad) * 1.65, (i % 2 == 0 and 0.3 or -0.4), math.sin(rad) * 1.65)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(18), rad, math.rad(15))
		local shard = createPart({
			Name = "CrystalShard_" .. i,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.85, 2.8, 0.85),
			Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CFrame = core.CFrame * offset,
			Anchored = anchored,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = model,
		})
		if not anchored then
			weldParts(core, shard)
		end
	end

	-- Lame scellée qui dépasse du sommet de la Pierre
	local blade = createPart({
		Name = "SealedBlade",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 4.2, 1.1),
		Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = core.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.6, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	local guard = createPart({
		Name = "CrossGuard",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.45, 2.6),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 42, 55),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	local grip = createPart({
		Name = "Grip",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.42, 1.4, 0.45),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 60, 35),
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.0, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	if not anchored then
		weldParts(core, blade)
		weldParts(core, guard)
		weldParts(core, grip)
	end

	-- Aura de particules lumineuses
	local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(stoneTier.CrystalColor, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.1)
	particles.Rate = 14
	particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
	particles.LightEmission = 1
	particles.Parent = core

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor
	light.Range = 14
	light.Brightness = 2.2
	light.Parent = core

	return model
end

-- Crée un modèle d'Épée 3D (exposée dans l'enclos du joueur ou tenue en main)
function ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(swordId: string, cframe: CFrame, anchored: boolean): Model
	local info = GameConfig.Swords[swordId] or GameConfig.Swords.WoodenDagger
	local rarity = GameConfig.Rarities[info.Rarity] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common
	local scale = info.Scale or 1.0

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = info.Name

	local handle = createPart({
		Name = "Handle",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.32 * scale, 1.3 * scale, 0.36 * scale),
		Color = info.HandleColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe,
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = handle

	local guard = createPart({
		Name = "Guard",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.5 * scale, 0.38 * scale, 2.2 * scale),
		Color = rarity.Color,
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 0.7 * scale, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local bladeLength = 4.0 * scale
	local blade = createPart({
		Name = "Blade",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.22 * scale, bladeLength, 0.85 * scale),
		Color = info.BladeColor,
		Material = if rarity.Order >= 3 then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 0.7 * scale + bladeLength / 2, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local coreGlow = createPart({
		Name = "CoreGlow",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.26 * scale, bladeLength * 0.85, 0.28 * scale),
		Color = info.GlowColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame,
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local pommel = createPart({
		Name = "Pommel",
		Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
		Size = Vector3.new(0.58 * scale, 0.58 * scale, 0.58 * scale),
		Color = rarity.Color,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, -0.75 * scale, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	if not anchored then
		weldParts(handle, guard)
		weldParts(handle, blade)
		weldParts(handle, coreGlow)
		weldParts(handle, pommel)
	end

	if rarity.Order >= 2 then
		local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color, info.GlowColor)
		particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35 * scale),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
		particles.Rate = 5 * rarity.Order
		particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5, 4)
		particles.LightEmission = 1
		particles.Parent = blade
	end

	return model
end

-- Crée une clôture (Fence) style barrière en bois/couleur comme dans l'image 1
function ModelBuilder.CreateFenceRect(parent: Instance, center: Vector3, width: number, depth: number, color: Color3, leaveFrontGap: boolean?)
	local folder = Instance.new("Model")
	folder.Name = "Fence"
	folder.Parent = parent

	local halfW = width / 2
	local halfD = depth / 2

	-- Poteaux aux coins
	local corners = {
		Vector3.new(-halfW, 1.8, -halfD),
		Vector3.new(halfW, 1.8, -halfD),
		Vector3.new(-halfW, 1.8, halfD),
		Vector3.new(halfW, 1.8, halfD),
	}
	for _, c in ipairs(corners) do
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(0.9, 3.6, 0.9),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + c),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
	end

	-- Barres horizontales (Haut et Bas)
	for _, yH in ipairs({ 1.1, 2.5 }) do
		-- Arrière (Z + halfD)
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.45, 0.45),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, yH, halfD)),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
		-- Gauche (X - halfW)
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, depth),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-halfW, yH, 0)),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
		-- Droite (X + halfW)
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, depth),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(halfW, yH, 0)),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
		-- Avant (Z - halfD) avec ou sans ouverture
		if not leaveFrontGap then
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.45, 0.45),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, yH, -halfD)),
				Color = color,
				Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
				TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
				CanCollide = true,
				Parent = folder,
			})
		else
			local segW = (width - 8) / 2
			if segW > 1 then
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(segW, 0.45, 0.45),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-halfW + segW / 2, yH, -halfD)),
					Color = color,
					Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
					TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
					CanCollide = true,
					Parent = folder,
				})
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(segW, 0.45, 0.45),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(halfW - segW / 2, yH, -halfD)),
					Color = color,
					Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
					TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
					CanCollide = true,
					Parent = folder,
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Crée un Garde de Zone (de plus en plus imposant et rapide selon la zone)
function ModelBuilder.CreateGuardianModel(stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier, spawnPos: Vector3): Model
	local s = stoneTier.GuardianScale
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = stoneTier.GuardianName

	local torso = createPart({
		Name = "HumanoidRootPart",
		Size = Vector3.new(3.2 * s, 4.2 * s, 2.0 * s),
		Color = stoneTier.GuardianColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnPos + Vector3.new(0, 2.6 * s, 0)),
		Anchored = true,
		CanCollide = true,
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = torso

	local head = createPart({
		Name = "Head",
		Size = Vector3.new(2.0 * s, 2.0 * s, 2.0 * s),
		Color = stoneTier.GuardianColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.1 * s, 0),
		Anchored = true,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	for _, side in ipairs({ -0.45, 0.45 }) do
		createPart({
			Name = "Eye",
			Size = Vector3.new(0.45 * s, 0.25 * s, 0.2 * s),
			Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(side * s, 0.2 * s, -0.95 * s),
			Anchored = true,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = model,
		})
	end

	-- Grande épée tenue par le Garde
	createPart({
		Name = "GuardBlade",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.4 * s, 5.5 * s, 1.1 * s),
		Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(2.1 * s, 1.0 * s, -1.2 * s) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(25), 0, 0),
		Anchored = true,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bg.Name = "GuardianTag"
	bg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 56)
	bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.8 * s, 0)
	bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bg.MaxDistance = 160
	bg.Parent = head

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Name = "Title"
	title.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.55)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = string.format("⚔️ %s (Vit: %d)", stoneTier.GuardianName, stoneTier.GuardianSpeed)
	title.TextColor3 = stoneTier.CrystalColor
	title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	title.TextScaled = true
	title.Parent = bg

	local status = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	status.Name = "Status"
	status.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.55)
	status.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.45)
	status.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	status.Text = "Garde la Zone " .. stoneTier.ZoneOrder
	status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	status.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	status.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	status.TextScaled = true
	status.Parent = bg

	return model
end

return ModelBuilder

--!strict
-- Serveur principal de "Voler une Épée" (Architecture fidèle aux captures d'écran)
-- Map : Grand Hub entouré de hauts murs + Enclos clôturés + Tapis de course de vitesse +
-- Longue Allée linéaire de 10 Zones progressives avec 1 Garde de plus en plus rapide par zone.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local GameConfig = require(Shared:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local ModelBuilder = require(Shared:WaitForChild("ModelBuilder"))

-- Dossier Remotes
local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
if Remotes then
	Remotes:Destroy()
end
Remotes = Instance.new("Folder")
Remotes.Name = "Remotes"
Remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local StateUpdateEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
StateUpdateEvent.Name = "StateUpdate"
StateUpdateEvent.Parent = Remotes

local NotificationEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
NotificationEvent.Name = "Notification"
NotificationEvent.Parent = Remotes

local SwordRevealEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
SwordRevealEvent.Name = "SwordReveal"
SwordRevealEvent.Parent = Remotes

local ActionEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
ActionEvent.Name = "PlayerAction"
ActionEvent.Parent = Remotes

local PopupEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
PopupEvent.Name = "FloatingPopup"
PopupEvent.Parent = Remotes

-- Nettoyage / Création de la Map
local MapFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("StealASwordMap")
if MapFolder then
	MapFolder:Destroy()
end
MapFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
MapFolder.Name = "StealASwordMap"
MapFolder.Parent = Workspace

local defaultBaseplate = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
if defaultBaseplate and defaultBaseplate:IsA("BasePart") then
	defaultBaseplate.Transparency = 1
	defaultBaseplate.CanCollide = false
end

local function createPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = if props.Anchored ~= nil then props.Anchored else true
	p.CanCollide = if props.CanCollide ~= nil then props.CanCollide else true
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.Plastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	p.TopSurface = props.TopSurface or Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Name then
		p.Name = props.Name
	end
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	if props.Parent then
		p.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return p
end

-- Crée un mur avec bordure verte au sommet exactement comme sur les images
local function createStyledWall(parent: Instance, cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3, wallColor: Color3?)
	local wColor = wallColor or Color3.fromRGB(185, 140, 88)
	local wall = createPart({
		Name = "PerimeterWall",
		Size = size,
		CFrame = cframe,
		Color = wColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Plastic,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	-- Bordure verte vive sur le dessus du mur
	createPart({
		Name = "WallTopGreen",
		Size = Vector3.new(size.X + 0.4, 2.2, size.Z + 0.4),
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 1.1, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 225, 45),
		Material = Enum.Material.Plastic,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	return wall
end

-- Types de données joueur
type AnvilSlot = {
	SlotIndex: number,
	StoneId: string?,
	EndTime: number?,
	Part: Part,
	StatusBillboard: BillboardGui,
	TitleLabel: TextLabel,
	SubLabel: TextLabel,
	Prompt: ProximityPrompt,
	VisualModel: Model?,
}

type PedestalSlot = {
	SlotIndex: number,
	SwordId: string?,
	Part: Part,
	BillboardLabel: TextLabel,
	VisualModel: Model?,
}

type PlayerSession = {
	Player: Player,
	Money: number,
	BonusSpeed: number, -- Vitesse gagnée sur le tapis de course ou en boutique
	SlowMode: boolean, -- Bouton "Mode lent" de l'interface
	SpeedBoostUntil: number, -- Potion x2 Vitesse
	MoneyBoostUntil: number, -- Potion x2 Argent
	CarryingStoneId: string?,
	CarriedModel: Model?,
	EquippedSwordId: string?,
	EquippedToolModel: Model?,
	Inventory: { string },
	Discovered: { [string]: boolean },
	Upgrades: {
		SpeedLevel: number,
		CarryStrength: number,
		ForgeSpeed: number,
		AnvilCount: number,
	},
	BaseIndex: number,
	BaseModel: Model,
	SpawnCFrame: CFrame,
	Anvils: { AnvilSlot },
	Pedestals: { PedestalSlot },
}

local PlayerSessions: { [Player]: PlayerSession } = {}
local AssignedBases: { [number]: Player? } = {}
local NightEventCycleEnd = os.clock() + 230 -- Compte à rebours "en 3 minutes 50 secondes" en bas à droite

-- Calcule la vitesse totale du joueur
local function getPlayerTotalSpeed(session: PlayerSession): number
	local base = 18 + (session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel - 1) * 10 + session.BonusSpeed
	if os.clock() < session.SpeedBoostUntil then
		base *= 2
	end
	return math.floor(base)
end

-- Calcule le revenu $/s total du joueur
local function getPlayerMoneyPerSec(session: PlayerSession): number
	local total = 0
	for _, ped in ipairs(session.Pedestals) do
		if ped.SwordId then
			local sword = GameConfig.Swords[ped.SwordId]
			if sword then
				total += sword.MoneyPerSec
			end
		end
	end
	if os.clock() < session.MoneyBoostUntil then
		total *= 2
	end
	return total
end

-- Applique la vitesse réelle au Humanoid du personnage
local function applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session: PlayerSession)
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then
		return
	end

	local speed = getPlayerTotalSpeed(session)

	-- Si "Mode lent" est activé dans l'UI à gauche
	if session.SlowMode then
		speed = math.min(speed, 22)
	end

	-- Ralentissement quand on porte une Pierre d'Épée
	if session.CarryingStoneId then
		local slowFactor = 0.7
		for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
			if tier.Id == session.CarryingStoneId then
				slowFactor = tier.CarrySlowFactor
				break
			end
		end
		local bonus = (session.Upgrades.CarryStrength - 1) * 0.03
		speed = math.max(12, speed * math.clamp(slowFactor + bonus, 0.45, 0.95))
	end

	hum.WalkSpeed = math.clamp(speed, 12, 260)
end

-- Synchronise l'état avec le client et le tableau des scores (Money/s et Vitesse comme sur l'image 2)
local function syncPlayerState(session: PlayerSession)
	local mps = getPlayerMoneyPerSec(session)
	local spd = getPlayerTotalSpeed(session)

	local leaderstats = session.Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		local mpsVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Money/s") :: StringValue?
		if mpsVal then
			mpsVal.Value = GameConfig.FormatNumber(mps)
		end
		local spdVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Vitesse") :: StringValue?
		if spdVal then
			spdVal.Value = GameConfig.FormatNumber(spd)
		end
	end

	StateUpdateEvent:FireClient(session.Player, {
		Money = session.Money,
		MoneyPerSec = mps,
		TotalSpeed = spd,
		TreadmillMultiplier = session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel,
		SlowMode = session.SlowMode,
		CarryingStoneId = session.CarryingStoneId,
		EquippedSwordId = session.EquippedSwordId,
		Inventory = session.Inventory,
		Discovered = session.Discovered,
		Upgrades = session.Upgrades,
		NightRemaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(NightEventCycleEnd - os.clock())),
		PotionRemaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(math.max(session.SpeedBoostUntil, session.MoneyBoostUntil) - os.clock())),
	})
end

-- Met à jour les épées exposées dans les enclos intérieurs du joueur
local function refreshBasePedestals(session: PlayerSession)
	local sorted = table.clone(session.Inventory)
	table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
		local sa = GameConfig.Swords[a]
		local sb = GameConfig.Swords[b]
		return (if sa then sa.MoneyPerSec else 0) > (if sb then sb.MoneyPerSec else 0)
	end)

	for i, ped in ipairs(session.Pedestals) do
		if ped.VisualModel then
			ped.VisualModel:Destroy()
			ped.VisualModel = nil
		end
		local swordId = sorted[i]
		ped.SwordId = swordId
		if swordId then
			local info = GameConfig.Swords[swordId]
			local rarity = GameConfig.Rarities[info.Rarity]
			local swordModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(
				swordId,
				ped.Part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.4, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(i * 35), math.rad(180)),
				true
			)
			swordModel.Parent = session.BaseModel
			ped.VisualModel = swordModel
			ped.BillboardLabel.Text = string.format("%s\n+$%s/s", info.Name, GameConfig.FormatNumber(info.MoneyPerSec))
			ped.BillboardLabel.TextColor3 = rarity.Color
		else
			ped.BillboardLabel.Text = ""
		end
	end
end

-- Équipe visuellement l'épée en main
local function equipSwordOnCharacter(session: PlayerSession, swordId: string)
	session.EquippedSwordId = swordId
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	if session.EquippedToolModel then
		session.EquippedToolModel:Destroy()
		session.EquippedToolModel = nil
	end

	local hand = (char:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) :: BasePart?
	if not hand then
		return
	end

	local swordModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(
		swordId,

		weld.Part1 = swordModel.PrimaryPart

local function clearCarriedStone(session: PlayerSession)
	session.CarryingStoneId = nil
	if session.CarriedModel then
		session.CarriedModel:Destroy()
		session.CarriedModel = nil
	end
	applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

local function giveCarriedStone(session: PlayerSession, stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier)
	clearCarriedStone(session)
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not hrp then
		return
	end

	session.CarryingStoneId = stoneTier.Id
	local stoneModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(stoneTier, hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.2, 0), true)
	stoneModel.Name = "CarriedSwordStone"
	stoneModel.Parent = char

	if stoneModel.PrimaryPart then
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = hrp
		weld.Part1 = stoneModel.PrimaryPart
		weld.Parent = stoneModel.PrimaryPart
	end

	session.CarriedModel = stoneModel
	applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

local function refreshAnvilLocks(session: PlayerSession)
	for _, anvil in ipairs(session.Anvils) do
		local unlocked = anvil.SlotIndex <= session.Upgrades.AnvilCount
		if unlocked then
			anvil.Part.Transparency = 0
			anvil.Prompt.Enabled = true
			if not anvil.StoneId then
				anvil.TitleLabel.Text = "Enclume #" .. anvil.SlotIndex
				anvil.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
				anvil.SubLabel.Text = "Pose une Pierre d'Épée"
			end
		else
			anvil.Part.Transparency = 0.4
			anvil.Prompt.Enabled = false
			anvil.TitleLabel.Text = "🔒 Verrouillé"
			anvil.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 180)
			anvil.SubLabel.Text = "Boutique"
		end
	end
end

-- Interaction avec le Nid / Enclume de Forge (Exactement comme "Oeuf Prêt! Éclosion! [E]" sur l'image 1)
local function onAnvilInteract(session: PlayerSession, anvil: AnvilSlot)
	if anvil.SlotIndex > session.Upgrades.AnvilCount then
		return
	end

	if not anvil.StoneId then
		if not session.CarryingStoneId then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				session.Player,
				"Va dans l'Allée des Zones pour voler une Pierre d'Épée !",
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 65)
			)
			return
		end

		local stoneId = session.CarryingStoneId
		local foundTier: GameConfig.StoneTier? = nil
		for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
			if tier.Id == stoneId then
				foundTier = tier
				break
			end
		end
		if not foundTier then
			return
		end

		clearCarriedStone(session)

		local speedMult = 1 + (session.Upgrades.ForgeSpeed - 1) * 0.20
		local duration = math.max(5, math.ceil(foundTier.ForgeTime / speedMult))

		anvil.StoneId = stoneId
		anvil.EndTime = os.clock() + duration
		anvil.Prompt.ObjectText = foundTier.Name
		anvil.Prompt.ActionText = "Forgeage en cours..."

		local stoneVisual = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(foundTier, anvil.Part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.8, 0), false)
		stoneVisual.Parent = session.BaseModel
		anvil.VisualModel = stoneVisual

		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			string.format("🔥 %s posée ! Temps de forge : %s", foundTier.Name, GameConfig.FormatTime(duration)),
			foundTier.CrystalColor
		)
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	if anvil.EndTime and now < anvil.EndTime then
		local rem = math.ceil(anvil.EndTime - now)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			"⏳ Forgeage en cours : encore " .. GameConfig.FormatTime(rem) .. " !",
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 80)
		)
		return
	end

	-- Pierre Prête -> Révélation de l'épée !
	local forgedStoneId = anvil.StoneId
	anvil.StoneId = nil
	anvil.EndTime = nil
	if anvil.VisualModel then
		anvil.VisualModel:Destroy()
		anvil.VisualModel = nil
	end
	anvil.Prompt.ObjectText = "Enclume de Forge"
	anvil.Prompt.ActionText = "Poser une Pierre"
	anvil.TitleLabel.Text = "Enclume #" .. anvil.SlotIndex
	anvil.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	anvil.SubLabel.Text = "Pose une Pierre d'Épée"

	local wonSwordId = GameConfig.RollSwordFromStone(forgedStoneId :: string)
	local swordInfo = GameConfig.Swords[wonSwordId]
	local rarityInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[swordInfo.Rarity]

	table.insert(session.Inventory, wonSwordId)
	session.Discovered[wonSwordId] = true

	equipSwordOnCharacter(session, wonSwordId)
	refreshBasePedestals(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)

	SwordRevealEvent:FireClient(session.Player, {
		SwordId = wonSwordId,
		Name = swordInfo.Name,
		Rarity = rarityInfo.Name,
		RarityColor = rarityInfo.Color,
		MoneyPerSec = swordInfo.MoneyPerSec,
	})
end

		titleLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		titleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne

		titleLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0

		prompt.ActionText = "Forger !"

		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12

			TitleLabel = titleLbl,
			SubLabel = subLbl,
			Prompt = prompt,
			VisualModel = nil,

			local sess = PlayerSessions[plr]
			if sess and sess.BaseIndex == baseIndex then
				onAnvilInteract(sess, slot)

		nestPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)

				return
			end
			local char = hit.Parent
			local plr = if char then Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char) else nil

		end)

		table.insert(anvils, slot)
