-- Actions du Client (Boutique, Mode lent, Équipement, Potions)
ActionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, actionType: string, payload: any)
	local sess = PlayerSessions[player]
	if not sess then
		return
	end

	if actionType == "ToggleSlowMode" then
		sess.SlowMode = not sess.SlowMode
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
		syncPlayerState(sess)

	elseif actionType == "BuyUpgrade" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		local upgConfig = GameConfig.Upgrades[payload]
		local currentLvl = (sess.Upgrades :: any)[payload]
		if not upgConfig or not currentLvl or currentLvl >= upgConfig.MaxLevel then
			return
		end
		local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(payload, currentLvl)
		if sess.Money < cost then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "Il te manque $" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost - sess.Money) .. " !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90))
			return
		end
		sess.Money -= cost
		;(sess.Upgrades :: any)[payload] = currentLvl + 1
		if payload == "AnvilCount" then
			refreshAnvilLocks(sess)
		end
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
		syncPlayerState(sess)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "✨ " .. upgConfig.Name .. " Niveau " .. (currentLvl + 1) .. " !", Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 125))

	elseif actionType == "EquipSword" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		if table.find(sess.Inventory, payload) then
			equipSwordOnCharacter(sess, payload)
		end

	elseif actionType == "ActivatePotion" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		local cost = 500
		if sess.Money < cost then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "Il faut $500 pour activer une Potion Boost (3 min) !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 95))
			return
		end
		sess.Money -= cost
		local now = os.clock()
		if payload == "Speed" then
			sess.SpeedBoostUntil = math.max(now, sess.SpeedBoostUntil) + 180
			applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "🧪 Potion x2 Vitesse activée pour 3 minutes !", Color3.fromRGB(85, 225, 255))
		else
			sess.MoneyBoostUntil = math.max(now, sess.MoneyBoostUntil) + 180
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "🧪 Potion x2 Argent activée pour 3 minutes !", Color3.fromRGB(95, 255, 120))
		end
		syncPlayerState(sess)
	end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	for _, g in ipairs(Guardians) do
		local root = g.Model.PrimaryPart
		if not root then
			continue
		end

		-- Chercher si un joueur se trouve actuellement dans la zone de ce Garde
		local targetPlayer: Player? = nil
		local targetPos: Vector3? = nil
		local bestDist = 999

		for _, sess in pairs(PlayerSessions) do
			local char = sess.Player.Character
			local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
			if hrp then
				local pPos = hrp.Position
				-- Le garde ne poursuit que les joueurs qui sont entrés dans sa zone (ou juste à la frontière s'ils portent une pierre)
				if pPos.Z <= g.ZoneZMax + 4 and pPos.Z >= g.ZoneZMin - 4 and math.abs(pPos.X) <= corridorWidth / 2 then
					local d = (pPos - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bestDist then
						bestDist = d
						targetPlayer = sess.Player
						targetPos = pPos
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local currentPos = root.Position
		local nextPos: Vector3
		local lookTarget: Vector3

		if targetPlayer and targetPos then
			if g.StatusLabel then
				g.StatusLabel.Text = "😡 POURSUITE : " .. targetPlayer.DisplayName .. " !"
				g.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
			end
			local dir = Vector3.new(targetPos.X - currentPos.X, 0, targetPos.Z - currentPos.Z)
			if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				nextPos = currentPos + dir.Unit * g.Tier.GuardianSpeed * dt
				lookTarget = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, currentPos.Y, targetPos.Z)
			else
				nextPos = currentPos
				lookTarget = currentPos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			if bestDist < 5.8 then
				local sess = PlayerSessions[targetPlayer]
				if sess then
					if sess.CarryingStoneId then
						clearCarriedStone(sess)
						NotificationEvent:FireClient(
							targetPlayer,
							string.format("💥 Le %s t'a rattrapé et a brisé ta Pierre d'Épée ! Entraîne ta Vitesse !", g.Tier.GuardianName),
							Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
						)
					else
						NotificationEvent:FireClient(
							targetPlayer,
							string.format("💥 Rattrapé par le %s (Vitesse %d) !", g.Tier.GuardianName, g.Tier.GuardianSpeed),
							Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 75)
						)
					end
					local char = targetPlayer.Character
					local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
					if hrp then
						hrp.CFrame = sess.SpawnCFrame
					end
				end
			end
		else
			-- Patrouille de gauche à droite au milieu de sa Zone
			if g.StatusLabel then
				g.StatusLabel.Text = "Garde la Zone " .. g.Tier.ZoneOrder
				g.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
			end
			local nextX = currentPos.X + g.PatrolDir * (g.Tier.GuardianSpeed * 0.55) * dt
			if nextX > 26 then
				nextX = 26
				g.PatrolDir = -1
			elseif nextX < -26 then
				nextX = -26
				g.PatrolDir = 1
			end
			nextPos = Vector3.new(nextX, currentPos.Y, g.HomePos.Z)
			lookTarget = nextPos + Vector3.new(g.PatrolDir, 0, 0)
		end

		local deltaCF = CFrame.lookAt(nextPos, lookTarget) * root.CFrame:Inverse()
		for _, part in ipairs(g.Model:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CFrame = deltaCF * part.CFrame
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- 8. RAFRAÎCHISSEMENT DE L'INTERFACE
-- ============================================================================
local function refreshUI()
	-- 1. Bannière hors ligne en haut : "Vous gagnez $.../jour hors ligne ! 😈"
	local dailyOffline = math.max(1000, currentState.MoneyPerSec * 86400)
	offlineLabel.Text = string.format("Vous gagnez $%s/jour hors ligne ! 😈", GameConfig.FormatNumber(dailyOffline))

	-- 2. Bas gauche : Vitesse (rose) et Argent (vert)
	if currentState.TreadmillMultiplier > 1 then
		speedValueLabel.Text = string.format("%s (x%d)", GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.TotalSpeed), currentState.TreadmillMultiplier)
	else
		speedValueLabel.Text = GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.TotalSpeed)
	end
	moneyValueLabel.Text = "$" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.Money)

	-- 3. Switch "Mode lent"
	if currentState.SlowMode then
		slowKnob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(41, 3)
		slowKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 50)
	else
		slowKnob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
		slowKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 240, 45)
	end

	-- 4. Timer Nuit en bas à droite
	local nm = math.floor(currentState.NightRemaining / 60)
	local ns = currentState.NightRemaining % 60
	nightText.Text = string.format("en %d minutes\n%d secondes", nm, ns)

	-- 5. Timer Potion à droite
	if currentState.PotionRemaining > 0 then
		potionTimerLabel.Text = GameConfig.FormatTime(currentState.PotionRemaining)
	else
		potionTimerLabel.Text = "Boosts"
	end

	-- 6. Boutique
	for _, upgId in ipairs(upgOrder) do
		local upgInfo = GameConfig.Upgrades[upgId]
		local row = upgradeRows[upgId]
		local lvl = (currentState.Upgrades :: any)[upgId] or 1
		row.Label.Text = string.format("%s (Niv. %d/%d)\n%s", upgInfo.Name, lvl, upgInfo.MaxLevel, upgInfo.Description)
		if lvl >= upgInfo.MaxLevel then
			row.Btn.Text = "MAX"
			row.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 105, 120)
		else
			local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(upgId, lvl)
			row.Btn.Text = "$" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost)
			row.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = if currentState.Money >= cost
				then Color3.fromRGB(55, 215, 75)
				else Color3.fromRGB(165, 60, 60)
		end
	end

	-- 7. Indice des 20 Épées
	for _, c in ipairs(indexList:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local allSwords = {}
	for _, sInfo in pairs(GameConfig.Swords) do
		table.insert(allSwords, sInfo)
	end
	table.sort(allSwords, function(a, b)
		return a.MoneyPerSec < b.MoneyPerSec
	end)
	for _, sInfo in ipairs(allSwords) do
		local rInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[sInfo.Rarity]
		local unlocked = currentState.Discovered[sInfo.Id] == true
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 54)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = if unlocked then Color3.fromRGB(36, 44, 62) else Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 32)
		row.Parent = indexList
		addCorner(row, 8)
		addStroke(row, if unlocked then rInfo.Color else Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85), 1.5, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border)

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -8)
		lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		lbl.TextColor3 = if unlocked then rInfo.Color else Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 145)
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		lbl.TextScaled = true
		lbl.Text = if unlocked
			then string.format("✅ [%s] %s  —  +$%s/s", rInfo.Name, sInfo.Name, GameConfig.FormatNumber(sInfo.MoneyPerSec))
			else string.format("🔒 [%s] ???  —  +$%s/s (Forge une Pierre pour débloquer)", rInfo.Name, GameConfig.FormatNumber(sInfo.MoneyPerSec))
		lbl.Parent = row
	end
	indexList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #allSwords * 62)

	-- 8. Inventaire des Épées du joueur
	for _, c in ipairs(invList:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local counts: { [string]: number } = {}
	for _, sId in ipairs(currentState.Inventory) do
		counts[sId] = (counts[sId] or 0) + 1
	end
	local unique = {}
	for sId, _ in pairs(counts) do
		table.insert(unique, sId)
	end
	table.sort(unique, function(a, b)
		return GameConfig.Swords[a].MoneyPerSec > GameConfig.Swords[b].MoneyPerSec
	end)
	for _, sId in ipairs(unique) do
		local sInfo = GameConfig.Swords[sId]
		local rInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[sInfo.Rarity]
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 58)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 42, 58)
		row.Parent = invList
		addCorner(row, 10)
		addStroke(row, rInfo.Color, 1.5, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border)

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.68, -10, 1, -8)

Analyzing the user's first request: a simplified base concept where placing a stone leads to an item that generates income, eliminating complex anvil slot mechanisms. The goal is a streamlined process: place stone, stone evolves, item generates resources. This represents a core design change request and warrants focused attention.


The proposed base simplification focuses on direct stone-to-item conversion within player emplacements, mirroring the "Steal an Egg" mechanic. Direct item generation and resource accumulation occur within the emplacement. This eliminates the need for external crafting interfaces.

The second request involves a deployable, single-player treadmill, mirroring the hotbar interface of the provided screenshot. This suggests personal, upgradeable equipment, with restrictions in certain zones.


Implementation requires a system to track and manage individual player treadmills, enforcing the single active treadmill limitation through location updates upon new placement. This system needs to associate treadmills with their owners, enabling speed bonuses and upgrades only for the designated player. Adding visual variety will require assigning textures to environmental elements, including repeating patterns and specific material effects.


Zone dimensions require adjusting; widening the runway necessitates progressively increasing zone lengths, creating a scaling difficulty curve dependent on distance. This increasing length intensifies the speed requirement for carrying heavy objects back through zones.

Exponential speed increases across zones are essential; the current linear progression is insufficient. Guard speeds need exponential growth to enforce the intended challenge.


Implementing logarithmic or root-based speed scaling is essential to manage extreme velocity values effectively, ensuring player control even with high stat numbers. The guard's `Vitesse` must exceed the player's to create the intended chase dynamic. This approach, similar to "Steal an Egg," prevents unmanageable speeds at high stat levels.


Guardian behavior requires a state-based system: idle, patrolling (if no stone), or chasing (if a stone is taken).  Guardian speed must be dynamically compared against player speed, using `TotalSpeed` and `GuardianSpeedStat` for a chase condition if the player has stolen an item. This design will introduce a core mechanic where the player can walk around to scope out items/bosses, but must run for their lives after picking up a specific item.

local SUFFIXES = { "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
function GameConfig.FormatNumber(n: number): string
	if n < 1000 then
		return tostring(math.floor(n))
	end
	local index = math.min(#SUFFIXES, math.floor(math.log10(n) / 3))
	local scaled = n / (10 ^ (index * 3))
	if scaled >= 100 then
		return string.format("%d%s", math.floor(scaled), SUFFIXES[index])
	else
		return string.format("%.1f%s", scaled, SUFFIXES[index]):gsub("%.0", "")
	end
end

function GameConfig.FormatTime(seconds: number): string
	seconds = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	if seconds < 60 then
		return string.format("%ds", seconds)
	elseif seconds < 3600 then
		local m = math.floor(seconds / 60)
		local s = seconds % 60
		if s == 0 then
			return string.format("%dm", m)
		end
		return string.format("%dm %ds", m, s)
	else
		local h = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
		local m = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
		return string.format("%dh %dm", h, m)
	end

-- Calcule le gain de vitesse par seconde sur le tapis de course selon son niveau
function GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(treadmillLevel: number): number
	-- Progression exponentielle pour atteindre les K, M, B de vitesse au fil des améliorations
	return math.floor(2 * (1.85 ^ (treadmillLevel - 1)))
end

function GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(upgradeId: string, currentLevel: number): number
	local upg = GameConfig.Upgrades[upgradeId]
	if not upg then
		return 999999
	end
	return math.floor(upg.BaseCost * (upg.CostMultiplier ^ (currentLevel - 1)))
end

-- Convertit une statistique de Vitesse (ex: 18, 5K, 400M) en WalkSpeed physique jouable dans Roblox (16 -> 155)
function GameConfig.StatSpeedToWalkSpeed(statSpeed: number): number
	if statSpeed <= 18 then
		return 16
	end
	-- Échelle logarithmique fluide : permet de sentir l'accélération tout en restant contrôlable
	local logVal = math.log10(statSpeed / 18 + 1)
	return math.clamp(16 + logVal * 16, 16, 155)
end

function GameConfig.RollSwordFromStone(stoneId: string): string
	for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
		if tier.Id == stoneId then
			local totalWeight = 0
			for _, weight in pairs(tier.DropTable) do
				totalWeight += weight
			end
			local roll = math.random() * totalWeight
			local cumulative = 0
			for swordId, weight in pairs(tier.DropTable) do
				cumulative += weight
				if roll <= cumulative then
					return swordId
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return "WoodenDagger"
end

return GameConfig

--!strict
-- Générateur de modèles 3D améliorés avec textures :
-- - Gardiens en armure complète articulée (Casque à cornes, Épaulières, Cape, Jambes, Bras, Épée géante)
-- - Tapis de course personnel déployable avec lave texturée et panneau d'amélioration intégré
-- - Pierres d'Épée cristallines et Épées 3D
-- - Textures de sol et de murs (Studs / Damier / Briques)

local GameConfig = require(script.Parent.GameConfig)

local ModelBuilder = {}

local function createPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = if props.Anchored ~= nil then props.Anchored else true
	p.CanCollide = if props.CanCollide ~= nil then props.CanCollide else false
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	p.TopSurface = props.TopSurface or Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.Name then
		p.Name = props.Name
	end
	if props.Parent then
		p.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return p
end

local function weldParts(root: BasePart, part: BasePart)
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Part0 = root
	w.Part1 = part
	w.Parent = root
end

-- Ajoute une texture répétée sur les faces d'une Part pour un rendu visuel riche
function ModelBuilder.ApplySurfaceTexture(part: BasePart, textureId: string, faces: { Enum.NormalId }, studsPerTile: number, transparency: number?, color: Color3?)
	for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
		local tex = Instance.new("Texture")
		tex.Texture = textureId
		tex.Face = face
		tex.StudsPerTileU = studsPerTile
		tex.StudsPerTileV = studsPerTile
		tex.Transparency = transparency or 0.65
		if color then
			tex.Color3 = color
		end
		tex.Parent = part
	end
end

-- Ajoute un damier texturé sur un sol (style Simulator / Steal an Egg)
function ModelBuilder.ApplyFloorVisuals(floorPart: BasePart, baseColor: Color3, material: Enum.Material?)
	floorPart.Color = baseColor
	floorPart.Material = material or Enum.Material.Plastic
	floorPart.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	-- Texture grille/damier subtile sur le dessus pour donner l'effet de relief et de vitesse
	ModelBuilder.ApplySurfaceTexture(
		floorPart,
		"rbxassetid://6372755229",
		{ Enum.NormalId.Top },
		16,
		0.78,
		Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	)
end

-- Crée une Pierre d'Épée cristalline (avec aura et lame scellée)
function ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier, cframe: CFrame, isCarried: boolean?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = stoneTier.Name

	local anchored = not isCarried

	local core = createPart({
		Name = "PrimaryPart",
		Size = Vector3.new(4.4, 5.4, 4.4),
		Color = stoneTier.StoneColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Rock,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = not isCarried,
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = core

	local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1.25, 1)
	mesh.Parent = core

	-- Anneau d'énergie autour de la pierre
	local ring = createPart({
		Name = "AuraRing",
		Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
		Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 6.2, 6.2),
		Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		Transparency = 0.25,
		CFrame = core.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	if not anchored then
		weldParts(core, ring)
	end

	-- Cristaux lumineux
	local shardAngles = { 0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315 }
	for i, deg in ipairs(shardAngles) do
		local rad = math.rad(deg)
		local offset = CFrame.new(math.cos(rad) * 1.8, (i % 2 == 0 and 0.4 or -0.5), math.sin(rad) * 1.8)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(22), rad, math.rad(18))
		local shard = createPart({
			Name = "CrystalShard_" .. i,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.85, 3.0, 0.85),
			Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CFrame = core.CFrame * offset,
			Anchored = anchored,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = model,
		})
		if not anchored then
			weldParts(core, shard)
		end
	end

	-- Lame scellée au sommet
	local blade = createPart({
		Name = "SealedBlade",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.38, 4.4, 1.15),
		Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = core.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.8, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	local guard = createPart({
		Name = "CrossGuard",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.65, 0.45, 2.7),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 38, 50),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.3, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	local grip = createPart({
		Name = "Grip",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.42, 1.4, 0.45),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 60, 35),
		Material = Enum.Material.Wood,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.1, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	if not anchored then
		weldParts(core, blade)
		weldParts(core, guard)
		weldParts(core, grip)
	end

	local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(stoneTier.CrystalColor, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.2)
	particles.Rate = 16
	particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
	particles.LightEmission = 1
	particles.Parent = core

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor
	light.Range = 15
	light.Brightness = 2.4
	light.Parent = core

	return model
end

-- Crée un modèle d'Épée 3D
function ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(swordId: string, cframe: CFrame, anchored: boolean): Model
	local info = GameConfig.Swords[swordId] or GameConfig.Swords.WoodenDagger
	local rarity = GameConfig.Rarities[info.Rarity] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common
	local scale = info.Scale or 1.0

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = info.Name

	local handle = createPart({
		Name = "Handle",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.34 * scale, 1.35 * scale, 0.38 * scale),
		Color = info.HandleColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe,
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = handle

	local guard = createPart({
		Name = "Guard",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.55 * scale, 0.42 * scale, 2.3 * scale),
		Color = rarity.Color,
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 0.72 * scale, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local bladeLength = 4.2 * scale
	local blade = createPart({
		Name = "Blade",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.24 * scale, bladeLength, 0.9 * scale),
		Color = info.BladeColor,
		Material = if rarity.Order >= 3 then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 0.72 * scale + bladeLength / 2, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local coreGlow = createPart({
		Name = "CoreGlow",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.28 * scale, bladeLength * 0.88, 0.3 * scale),
		Color = info.GlowColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame,
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local pommel = createPart({
		Name = "Pommel",
		Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
		Size = Vector3.new(0.62 * scale, 0.62 * scale, 0.62 * scale),
		Color = rarity.Color,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, -0.78 * scale, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	if not anchored then
		weldParts(handle, guard)
		weldParts(handle, blade)
		weldParts(handle, coreGlow)
		weldParts(handle, pommel)
	end

	if rarity.Order >= 2 then
		local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color, info.GlowColor)
		particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.38 * scale),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
		particles.Rate = 6 * rarity.Order
		particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5, 4)
		particles.LightEmission = 1
		particles.Parent = blade
	end

	return model
end

-- Crée une barrière / clôture propre
function ModelBuilder.CreateFenceRect(parent: Instance, center: Vector3, width: number, depth: number, color: Color3, leaveFrontGap: boolean?)
	local folder = Instance.new("Model")
	folder.Name = "Fence"
	folder.Parent = parent

	local halfW = width / 2
	local halfD = depth / 2

	local corners = {
		Vector3.new(-halfW, 2.0, -halfD),
		Vector3.new(halfW, 2.0, -halfD),
		Vector3.new(-halfW, 2.0, halfD),
		Vector3.new(halfW, 2.0, halfD),
	}
	for _, c in ipairs(corners) do
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(1.1, 4.0, 1.1),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + c),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
	end

	for _, yH in ipairs({ 1.2, 2.8 }) do
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.5, 0.5),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, yH, halfD)),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, depth),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-halfW, yH, 0)),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, depth),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(halfW, yH, 0)),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
		if not leaveFrontGap then
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.5, 0.5),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, yH, -halfD)),
				Color = color,
				Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
				TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
				CanCollide = true,
				Parent = folder,
			})
		else
			local segW = (width - 14) / 2
			if segW > 1 then
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(segW, 0.5, 0.5),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-halfW + segW / 2, yH, -halfD)),
					Color = color,
					Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
					TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
					CanCollide = true,
					Parent = folder,
				})
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(segW, 0.5, 0.5),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(halfW - segW / 2, yH, -halfD)),
					Color = color,
					Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
					TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
					CanCollide = true,
					Parent = folder,
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Anime les membres du Gardien (Jambes, Bras, Épée, Cape) autour de son HumanoidRootPart
function ModelBuilder.PositionAndAnimateGuardian(model: Model, scale: number, rootCF: CFrame, animTime: number, isChasing: boolean)
	local s = scale
	local swingAmp = if isChasing then math.rad(42) else math.rad(22)
	local swing = math.sin(animTime * (if isChasing then 10 else 5)) * swingAmp

	local torso = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if torso then
		torso.CFrame = rootCF
	end
	local emblem = model:FindFirstChild("ChestEmblem") :: BasePart?
	if emblem then
		emblem.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.3 * s, -0.85 * s) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45))
	end
	local belt = model:FindFirstChild("Belt") :: BasePart?
	if belt then
		belt.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -1.35 * s, 0)
	end
	local cape = model:FindFirstChild("Cape") :: BasePart?
	if cape then
		local capeWave = math.rad(14) + math.abs(swing) * 0.4
		cape.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.6 * s, 1.2 * s) * CFrame.Angles(capeWave, 0, 0)
	end
	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	if head then
		head.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 2.75 * s, 0)
		local visor = model:FindFirstChild("VisorGlow") :: BasePart?
		if visor then
			visor.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.15 * s, -0.95 * s)
		end
	end

	local leftArm = model:FindFirstChild("LeftArm") :: BasePart?
	if leftArm then
		leftArm.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(-2.15 * s, 1.1 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.2 * s, 0)
	end
	local rightArm = model:FindFirstChild("RightArm") :: BasePart?
	if rightArm then
		local rAngle = if isChasing then math.rad(35) - swing * 0.7 else -swing
		rightArm.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(2.15 * s, 1.1 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(rAngle, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.2 * s, 0)
		local blade = model:FindFirstChild("GuardBlade") :: BasePart?
		if blade then
			blade.CFrame = rightArm.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -1.0 * s, -2.4 * s) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75), 0, 0)
		end
	end

	local leftLeg = model:FindFirstChild("LeftLeg") :: BasePart?
	if leftLeg then
		leftLeg.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(-0.85 * s, -1.6 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.6 * s, 0)
	end
	local rightLeg = model:FindFirstChild("RightLeg") :: BasePart?
	if rightLeg then
		rightLeg.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0.85 * s, -1.6 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.6 * s, 0)
	end

	local hornIdx = 0
	for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			if child.Name == "HelmetHorn" and head then
				hornIdx += 1
				local side = if hornIdx == 1 then -1 else 1
				child.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(side * 1.05 * s, 0.9 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-15), 0, math.rad(-side * 28))
			elseif child.Name == "Pauldron" then
				local side = if child.Position.X < rootCF.Position.X then -1 else 1
				child.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(side * 2.1 * s, 1.2 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-side * 15))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Crée le Tapis de Course Personnel déployable par un joueur (avec Panneau d'Amélioration intégré)
function ModelBuilder.CreatePersonalTreadmill(ownerName: string, centerPos: Vector3, level: number, gainPerTick: number, upgradeCost: number): (Model, Part, ProximityPrompt, TextLabel, TextLabel)
	local tm = Instance.new("Model")
	tm.Name = "PersonalTreadmill_" .. ownerName

	local belt = createPart({
		Name = "LavaBelt",
		Size = Vector3.new(9, 1.0, 18),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 20),
		Material = Enum.Material.CrackedLava,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		Parent = tm,
	})
	tm.PrimaryPart = belt
	ModelBuilder.ApplySurfaceTexture(belt, "rbxassetid://6372755229", { Enum.NormalId.Top }, 6, 0.55, Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 60))

	-- Cadre latéral en roche volcanique
	for _, side in ipairs({ -5.1, 5.1 }) do
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 2.0, 19),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(side, 0.5, 0)),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 42, 35),
			Material = Enum.Material.Basalt,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			Parent = tm,
		})
	end

	-- Arche avant avec braseros enflammés
	for _, side in ipairs({ -5.1, 5.1 }) do
		local pillar = createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 9.5, 1.8),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(side, 4.7, -8.5)),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(75, 45, 35),
			Material = Enum.Material.Brick,
			Parent = tm,
		})
		local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
		fire.Size = 4
		fire.Heat = 6
		fire.Parent = pillar
	end

	createPart({
		Size = Vector3.new(12.2, 1.8, 2.0),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(0, 9.5, -8.5)),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 35, 28),
		Material = Enum.Material.Brick,
		Parent = tm,
	})

	-- Billboard au-dessus du tapis (indiquant le propriétaire exclusif et le gain)
	local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 62)
	bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 12.5, -8.5)
	bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bg.MaxDistance = 120
	bg.Parent = belt

	local titleLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	titleLbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	titleLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	titleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	titleLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 230)
	titleLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	titleLbl.TextScaled = true
	titleLbl.Text = string.format("👟 Tapis de %s (Niv. %d)\n+%s Vitesse / pas", ownerName, level, GameConfig.FormatNumber(gainPerTick))
	titleLbl.Parent = bg

	-- Panneau noir d'amélioration juste à droite du tapis (comme sur l'image 2)
	local board = createPart({
		Name = "UpgradeStand",
		Size = Vector3.new(6.2, 5.2, 1.1),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(9.5, 3.0, -2)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-22), 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(22, 26, 36),
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		Parent = tm,
	})

	local boardBg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	boardBg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 75)
	boardBg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
	boardBg.AlwaysOnTop = true
	boardBg.MaxDistance = 90
	boardBg.Parent = board

	local boardLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	boardLbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	boardLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	boardLbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	boardLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 110)
	boardLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	boardLbl.TextScaled = true
	boardLbl.Text = string.format("Améliorer Tapis\nNiv. %d -> Niv. %d\n💵 $%s", level, level + 1, GameConfig.FormatNumber(upgradeCost))
	boardLbl.Parent = boardBg

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ObjectText = "Tapis de " .. ownerName
	prompt.ActionText = "Améliorer ($" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(upgradeCost) .. ")"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.Parent = board

	return tm, belt, prompt, titleLbl, boardLbl
end

--!strict

-- Dossier Remotes

	Remotes:Destroy()
end

Remotes.Name = "Remotes"
Remotes.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function createPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = if props.Anchored ~= nil then props.Anchored else true
	p.CanCollide = if props.CanCollide ~= nil then props.CanCollide else true
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.Plastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	p.TopSurface = props.TopSurface or Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Name then
		p.Name = props.Name
	end
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	if props.Parent then
		p.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return p
end

local function createStyledWall(parent: Instance, cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3, wallColor: Color3?)

	local wall = createPart({
		Name = "PerimeterWall",

		CFrame = cframe,
		Color = wColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Brick,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	ModelBuilder.ApplySurfaceTexture(
		wall,
		"rbxassetid://6372755229",
		{ Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back, Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Right },
		12,
		0.72,
		Color3.new(0, 0, 0)

	createPart({
		Name = "WallTopGreen",
		Size = Vector3.new(size.X + 0.6, 2.5, size.Z + 0.6),
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 1.25, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 225, 45),
		Material = Enum.Material.Plastic,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs,
		Parent = parent,
	})
	return wall
end

	StoneId: string?,

	Model: Model,
	Belt: Part,

type PlayerSession = {
	Player: Player,
	Money: number,
	TrainedSpeed: number, -- Vitesse gagnée par le joueur sur son tapis de course
	SlowMode: boolean,
	SpeedBoostUntil: number,

	CarryingStoneId: string?,
	CarriedModel: Model?,

local PlayerSessions: { [Player]: PlayerSession } = {}
local AssignedBases: { [number]: Player? } = {}
local NightEventCycleEnd = os.clock() + 230

-- Limite Z entre le Hub (Z > 35) et l'Allée des Zones de Pierres (Z <= 35)
local RUNWAY_START_Z = 35
local CORRIDOR_WIDTH = 130

local function getPlayerTotalSpeed(session: PlayerSession): number
	local spd = 18 + session.TrainedSpeed
	if os.clock() < session.SpeedBoostUntil then
		spd *= 2
	end
	return math.floor(spd)
end

local function getPlayerMoneyPerSec(session: PlayerSession): number
	local total = 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(session.Slots) do
		if slot.State == "Sword" and slot.SwordId then
			local sword = GameConfig.Swords[slot.SwordId]
			if sword then
				total += sword.MoneyPerSec
			end
		end
	end
	if os.clock() < session.MoneyBoostUntil then
		total *= 2
	end
	return total
end

local function applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session: PlayerSession)
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then
		return
	end

	local statSpeed = getPlayerTotalSpeed(session)
	local walkSpeed = GameConfig.StatSpeedToWalkSpeed(statSpeed)

	if session.SlowMode then
		walkSpeed = 20
	end

	if session.CarryingStoneId then
		local slowFactor = 0.72
		for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
			if tier.Id == session.CarryingStoneId then
				slowFactor = tier.CarrySlowFactor
				break
			end
		end
		local bonus = (session.Upgrades.CarryStrength - 1) * 0.03
		walkSpeed = math.max(13, walkSpeed * math.clamp(slowFactor + bonus, 0.45, 0.95))
	end

	hum.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed
end

local function syncPlayerState(session: PlayerSession)
	local mps = getPlayerMoneyPerSec(session)
	local spd = getPlayerTotalSpeed(session)

	local leaderstats = session.Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		local mpsVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Money/s") :: StringValue?
		if mpsVal then
			mpsVal.Value = GameConfig.FormatNumber(mps)
		end
		local spdVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Vitesse") :: StringValue?
		if spdVal then
			spdVal.Value = GameConfig.FormatNumber(spd)
		end
	end

	StateUpdateEvent:FireClient(session.Player, {
		Money = session.Money,
		MoneyPerSec = mps,
		TotalSpeed = spd,
		TreadmillLevel = session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel,
		TreadmillGain = GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel),
		SlowMode = session.SlowMode,
		CarryingStoneId = session.CarryingStoneId,
		EquippedSwordId = session.EquippedSwordId,
		Inventory = session.Inventory,
		Discovered = session.Discovered,
		Upgrades = session.Upgrades,
		NightRemaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(NightEventCycleEnd - os.clock())),
		PotionRemaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(math.max(session.SpeedBoostUntil, session.MoneyBoostUntil) - os.clock())),
	})
end

local function equipSwordOnCharacter(session: PlayerSession, swordId: string)
	session.EquippedSwordId = swordId
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	if session.EquippedToolModel then
		session.EquippedToolModel:Destroy()
		session.EquippedToolModel = nil
	end

	local hand = (char:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) :: BasePart?
	if not hand then
		return
	end

	local swordModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(
		swordId,
		hand.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0),
		false
	)
	swordModel.Name = "EquippedSwordVisual"
	swordModel.Parent = char

	if swordModel.PrimaryPart then
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = hand
		weld.Part1 = swordModel.PrimaryPart
		weld.Parent = swordModel.PrimaryPart
	end

	session.EquippedToolModel = swordModel
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

local function clearCarriedStone(session: PlayerSession)
	session.CarryingStoneId = nil
	if session.CarriedModel then
		session.CarriedModel:Destroy()
		session.CarriedModel = nil
	end
	applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

local function giveCarriedStone(session: PlayerSession, stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier)
	clearCarriedStone(session)
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not hrp then
		return
	end

	session.CarryingStoneId = stoneTier.Id
	local stoneModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(stoneTier, hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.2, 0), true)
	stoneModel.Name = "CarriedSwordStone"
	stoneModel.Parent = char

	if stoneModel.PrimaryPart then
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = hrp
		weld.Part1 = stoneModel.PrimaryPart
		weld.Parent = stoneModel.PrimaryPart
	end

	session.CarriedModel = stoneModel
	applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

local function updateTreadmillLabels(session: PlayerSession)
	local tm = session.Treadmill
	if not tm then
		return
	end
	local lvl = session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel
	local gain = GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(lvl)
	local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost("SpeedLevel", lvl)
	tm.TitleLabel.Text = string.format("👟 Tapis de %s (Niv. %d)\n+%s Vitesse / pas", session.Player.DisplayName, lvl, GameConfig.FormatNumber(gain))
	if lvl >= GameConfig.Upgrades.SpeedLevel.MaxLevel then
		tm.BoardLabel.Text = string.format("Tapis Niveau MAX (%d)", lvl)
		tm.Prompt.ActionText = "Niveau MAX"
	else
		tm.BoardLabel.Text = string.format("Améliorer Tapis\nNiv. %d -> Niv. %d\n💵 $%s", lvl, lvl + 1, GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost))
		tm.Prompt.ActionText = "Améliorer ($" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost) .. ")"
	end
end

local function spawnOrMovePersonalTreadmill(session: PlayerSession, targetPos: Vector3, notifyPlayer: boolean)
	-- Interdiction stricte de faire spawn le tapis dans les zones de pierres d'épée (Z <= RUNWAY_START_Z + 12)
	if targetPos.Z <= RUNWAY_START_Z + 12 then
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			"⛔ Impossible de poser ton Tapis de Course dans les Zones de Pierres ! Pose-le dans le Hub !",
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		)
		return
	end

	-- Détruire l'ancien tapis du joueur pour qu'il n'en ait jamais plus d'un seul !
	if session.Treadmill and session.Treadmill.Model then
		session.Treadmill.Model:Destroy()
		session.Treadmill = nil
	end

	local cleanPos = Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(targetPos.X, -155, 155),
		0.6,
		math.clamp(targetPos.Z, RUNWAY_START_Z + 16, 255)
	)

	local lvl = session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel
	local gain = GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(lvl)
	local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost("SpeedLevel", lvl)

	local model, belt, prompt, titleLbl, boardLbl = ModelBuilder.CreatePersonalTreadmill(
		session.Player.DisplayName,
		cleanPos,
		lvl,
		gain,
		cost
	)
	model.Parent = MapFolder

	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(triggerPlr: Player)
		if triggerPlr ~= session.Player then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				triggerPlr,
				"⛔ Ce Tapis de Course appartient à " .. session.Player.DisplayName .. " ! Déploie le tien avec le bouton Tapis !",
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 95)
			)
			return
		end
		local curLvl = session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel
		if curLvl >= GameConfig.Upgrades.SpeedLevel.MaxLevel then
			return
		end
		local upgCost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost("SpeedLevel", curLvl)
		if session.Money < upgCost then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				session.Player,
				"Pas assez d'Argent ! Il faut $" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(upgCost),
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85)
			)
			return
		end
		session.Money -= upgCost
		session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel += 1
		updateTreadmillLabels(session)
		syncPlayerState(session)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			string.format("👟 Tapis de Course amélioré au Niveau %d (+%s Vitesse/pas) !", session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel, GameConfig.FormatNumber(GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel))),
			Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 130)
		)
	end)

	session.Treadmill = {
		Model = model,
		Belt = belt,
		Prompt = prompt,
		TitleLabel = titleLbl,
		BoardLabel = boardLbl,
	}

	if notifyPlayer then
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			"👟 Ton Tapis de Course personnel a été posé ici !",
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 235)
		)
	end
end

-- Donne au joueur l'outil "🏃 Poser Tapis" dans sa barre d'inventaire en bas de l'écran
local function giveTreadmillSpawnerTool(player: Player)
	local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 5)
	if not backpack then
		return
	end
	if backpack:FindFirstChild("Poser Tapis") or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Poser Tapis")) then
		return
	end

	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = "Poser Tapis"
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	tool.CanBeDropped = false

	local handle = createPart({
		Name = "Handle",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 0.5, 2.0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 25),
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		Anchored = false,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = tool,
	})
	local _ = handle

	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local sess = PlayerSessions[player]
		if not sess then
			return
		end
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
		if hrp then
			local forwardPos = hrp.Position + hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 12
			spawnOrMovePersonalTreadmill(sess, forwardPos, true)
		end
	end)

	tool.Parent = backpack
end

local function refreshSlotVisuals(session: PlayerSession, slot: BaseSlot)
	local unlocked = slot.SlotIndex <= session.Upgrades.SlotCount
	if not unlocked then
		slot.PadPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85)
		slot.PadPart.Transparency = 0.5
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = false
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = false
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = "🔒 Verrouillé"
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 170, 180)
		slot.SubLabel.Text = "Boutique (+Emplacement)"
		return
	end

	slot.PadPart.Transparency = 0
	if slot.State == "Empty" then
		slot.PadPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 235, 65)
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = "Emplacement Libre"
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		slot.SubLabel.Text = "Rentre avec une Pierre !"
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = true
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ObjectText = "Emplacement #" .. slot.SlotIndex
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ActionText = "Poser la Pierre d'Épée"
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = false

	elseif slot.State == "Forging" then
		slot.PadPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 45)
		local rem = if slot.EndTime then math.max(0, math.ceil(slot.EndTime - os.clock())) else 0
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = "Éclosion en cours..."
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 65)
		slot.SubLabel.Text = "⏳ " .. GameConfig.FormatTime(rem)
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = false
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = false

	elseif slot.State == "Ready" then
		slot.PadPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = "Pierre\nPrête!"
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
		slot.SubLabel.Text = "Éclosion !\n[E] Ouvrir !"
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = true
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ObjectText = "Pierre Prête !"
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ActionText = "Éclosion !"
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = false

	elseif slot.State == "Sword" and slot.SwordId then
		local info = GameConfig.Swords[slot.SwordId]
		local rarity = GameConfig.Rarities[info.Rarity]
		slot.PadPart.Color = rarity.Color
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = string.format("[%s] %s", rarity.Name, info.Name)
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = rarity.Color
		slot.SubLabel.Text = string.format("+$%s / sec", GameConfig.FormatNumber(info.MoneyPerSec))
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = true
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ObjectText = info.Name
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ActionText = "Équiper dans la main"
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = true
	end
end

local function refreshAllBaseSlots(session: PlayerSession)
	for _, slot in ipairs(session.Slots) do
		refreshSlotVisuals(session, slot)
	end
end

-- Pose automatiquement ou manuellement la Pierre portée sur un emplacement libre
local function placeCarriedStoneOnSlot(session: PlayerSession, slot: BaseSlot): boolean
	if slot.SlotIndex > session.Upgrades.SlotCount or slot.State ~= "Empty" or not session.CarryingStoneId then
		return false
	end

	local stoneId = session.CarryingStoneId
	local foundTier: GameConfig.StoneTier? = nil
	for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
		if tier.Id == stoneId then
			foundTier = tier
			break
		end
	end
	if not foundTier then
		return false
	end

	clearCarriedStone(session)

	local speedMult = 1 + (session.Upgrades.ForgeSpeed - 1) * 0.25
	local duration = math.max(4, math.ceil(foundTier.ForgeTime / speedMult))

	slot.State = "Forging"
	slot.StoneId = stoneId
	slot.EndTime = os.clock() + duration

	if slot.VisualModel then
		slot.VisualModel:Destroy()
	end
	local stoneModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(foundTier, slot.PadPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0), false)
	stoneModel.Parent = session.BaseModel
	slot.VisualModel = stoneModel

	refreshSlotVisuals(session, slot)
	NotificationEvent:FireClient(
		session.Player,
		string.format("🪨 %s déposée dans ta base ! Éclosion dans %s", foundTier.Name, GameConfig.FormatTime(duration)),
		foundTier.CrystalColor
	)
	return true
end

-- Éclosion de la Pierre -> L'Épée apparaît directement sur cet emplacement et génère de l'argent !
local function hatchStoneOnSlot(session: PlayerSession, slot: BaseSlot)
	if slot.State ~= "Ready" or not slot.StoneId then
		return
	end

	local forgedStoneId = slot.StoneId
	slot.StoneId = nil
	slot.EndTime = nil
	if slot.VisualModel then
		slot.VisualModel:Destroy()
		slot.VisualModel = nil
	end

	local wonSwordId = GameConfig.RollSwordFromStone(forgedStoneId)
	local swordInfo = GameConfig.Swords[wonSwordId]
	local rarityInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[swordInfo.Rarity]

	slot.State = "Sword"
	slot.SwordId = wonSwordId

	local swordModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(
		wonSwordId,
		slot.PadPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(180)),
		true
	)
	swordModel.Parent = session.BaseModel
	slot.VisualModel = swordModel

	table.insert(session.Inventory, wonSwordId)
	session.Discovered[wonSwordId] = true

	equipSwordOnCharacter(session, wonSwordId)
	refreshSlotVisuals(session, slot)
	syncPlayerState(session)

	SwordRevealEvent:FireClient(session.Player, {
		SwordId = wonSwordId,
		Name = swordInfo.Name,
		Rarity = rarityInfo.Name,
		RarityColor = rarityInfo.Color,
		MoneyPerSec = swordInfo.MoneyPerSec,
	})
end

local function buildSimplePlayerBase(baseIndex: number, plotCenter: Vector3, fenceColor: Color3)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "PlayerBase_" .. baseIndex
	model.Parent = MapFolder

	-- Sol propre de la base du joueur + clôture extérieure avec grande entrée
	local baseFloor = createPart({
		Name = "BaseFloor",
		Size = Vector3.new(58, 0.4, 44),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(plotCenter + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)),
		Parent = model,
	})
	ModelBuilder.ApplyFloorVisuals(baseFloor, Color3.fromRGB(122, 238, 58), Enum.Material.Plastic)
	ModelBuilder.CreateFenceRect(model, plotCenter, 58, 44, fenceColor, true)

	-- Zone de détection à l'entrée de la base : dès que le joueur rentre dans sa base avec une Pierre, elle se pose toute seule sur un emplacement libre !
	local autoDropZone = createPart({
		Name = "AutoDropTrigger",
		Size = Vector3.new(54, 10, 40),
		CFrame = CFrame.new(plotCenter + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)),
		Transparency = 1,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	autoDropZone.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		local char = hit.Parent
		local plr = if char then Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char) else nil
		if not plr then
			return
		end
		local sess = PlayerSessions[plr]
		if sess and sess.BaseIndex == baseIndex and sess.CarryingStoneId then

local function spawnSwordStoneAt(slot: ActiveStoneSpawn)
	if slot.CurrentModel then
		slot.CurrentModel:Destroy()
		slot.CurrentModel = nil
	end

	local model = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(slot.Tier, CFrame.new(slot.SpawnPos), false)
	model.Parent = MapFolder
	slot.CurrentModel = model

	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then
		return
	end

	local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 60)
	bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 5.5, 0)
	bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bg.MaxDistance = 150
	bg.Parent = root

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	lbl.TextColor3 = slot.Tier.CrystalColor
	lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	lbl.TextScaled = true
	lbl.Text = string.format("%s\n⏳ Éclosion : %s", slot.Tier.Name, GameConfig.FormatTime(slot.Tier.ForgeTime))
	lbl.Parent = bg

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ObjectText = slot.Tier.Name
	prompt.ActionText = "Voler ! (" .. GameConfig.FormatTime(slot.Tier.ForgeTime) .. ")"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.15
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.Parent = root

	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(plr: Player)
		local sess = PlayerSessions[plr]
		if not sess then
			return
		end
		if sess.CarryingStoneId then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(plr, "Tu portes déjà une Pierre d'Épée ! Ramène-la dans ta Base !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 55))
			return
		end
		if not slot.CurrentModel then
			return
		end

		slot.CurrentModel:Destroy()
		slot.CurrentModel = nil
		slot.RespawnAt = os.clock() + 10

		giveCarriedStone(sess, slot.Tier)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			plr,
			string.format("⚠️ %s volée ! Le %s (Vit: %s) se réveille, cours à ta Base !", slot.Tier.Name, slot.Tier.GuardianName, GameConfig.FormatNumber(slot.Tier.GuardianSpeedStat)),
			slot.Tier.CrystalColor
		)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local chosenIndex = 1
	for i = 1, 4 do
		if not AssignedBases[i] then
			chosenIndex = i
			AssignedBases[i] = player
			break
		end
	end

	local baseSlot = BaseSlotsData[chosenIndex]
	baseSlot.OwnerNameLabel.Text = player.DisplayName
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, content = pcall(function()
			return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(player.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
		end)
		if ok and content then
			baseSlot.AvatarImage.Image = content
		end
	end)

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local mpsVal = Instance.new("StringValue")
	mpsVal.Name = "Money/s"
	mpsVal.Value = "0"
	mpsVal.Parent = leaderstats

	local spdVal = Instance.new("StringValue")
	spdVal.Name = "Vitesse"
	spdVal.Value = "18"
	spdVal.Parent = leaderstats

	local session: PlayerSession = {
		Player = player,
		Money = 60,
		TrainedSpeed = 0,
		SlowMode = false,
		SpeedBoostUntil = 0,
		MoneyBoostUntil = 0,
		CarryingStoneId = nil,
		CarriedModel = nil,
		EquippedSwordId = nil,
		EquippedToolModel = nil,
		Inventory = {},
		Discovered = {},
		Upgrades = {
			SpeedLevel = 1,
			CarryStrength = 1,
			ForgeSpeed = 1,
			SlotCount = 4, -- Commence avec 4 emplacements débloqués dans sa base
		},
		BaseIndex = chosenIndex,
		BaseCenter = baseSlot.Center,
		BaseModel = baseSlot.Model,
		SpawnCFrame = baseSlot.SpawnCFrame,
		Slots = baseSlot.Slots,
		Treadmill = nil,
	}
	PlayerSessions[player] = session

	refreshAllBaseSlots(session)

	-- Faire apparaître son Tapis de Course personnel par défaut juste devant sa base (il peut le déplacer où il veut dans le Hub !)
	local defaultTreadmillPos = baseSlot.Center + Vector3.new(if baseSlot.Center.X < 0 then 45 else -45, 0, -10)
	spawnOrMovePersonalTreadmill(session, defaultTreadmillPos, false)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char: Model)
		task.wait(0.15)
		local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5) :: BasePart?
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = session.SpawnCFrame
		end
		session.CarryingStoneId = nil
		session.CarriedModel = nil
		if session.EquippedSwordId then
			equipSwordOnCharacter(session, session.EquippedSwordId)
		end
		giveTreadmillSpawnerTool(player)
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
		syncPlayerState(session)
	end)

	if player.Character then
		local hrp = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = session.SpawnCFrame
		end
		giveTreadmillSpawnerTool(player)
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
	end

	task.delay(0.5, function()
		syncPlayerState(session)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local sess = PlayerSessions[player]
	if sess then
		AssignedBases[sess.BaseIndex] = nil
		local baseSlot = BaseSlotsData[sess.BaseIndex]
		if baseSlot then
			baseSlot.OwnerNameLabel.Text = "Base Libre"
			baseSlot.AvatarImage.Image = ""
		end
		if sess.Treadmill and sess.Treadmill.Model then
			sess.Treadmill.Model:Destroy()
			sess.Treadmill = nil
		end
		for _, slot in ipairs(sess.Slots) do
			slot.State = "Empty"
			slot.StoneId = nil
			slot.EndTime = nil
			slot.SwordId = nil
			if slot.VisualModel then
				slot.VisualModel:Destroy()
				slot.VisualModel = nil
			end
		end
		PlayerSessions[player] = nil
	end
end

-- Actions envoyées par l'UI Client
ActionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, actionType: string, payload: any)
	local sess = PlayerSessions[player]
	if not sess then
		return
	end

	if actionType == "ToggleSlowMode" then
		sess.SlowMode = not sess.SlowMode
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
		syncPlayerState(sess)

	elseif actionType == "SpawnTreadmill" then
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
		if hrp then
			local targetPos = hrp.Position + hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 12
			spawnOrMovePersonalTreadmill(sess, targetPos, true)
		end

	elseif actionType == "BuyUpgrade" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		local upgConfig = GameConfig.Upgrades[payload]
		local currentLvl = (sess.Upgrades :: any)[payload]
		if not upgConfig or not currentLvl or currentLvl >= upgConfig.MaxLevel then
			return
		end
		local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(payload, currentLvl)
		if sess.Money < cost then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "Il te manque $" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost - sess.Money) .. " !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90))
			return
		end
		sess.Money -= cost
		;(sess.Upgrades :: any)[payload] = currentLvl + 1
		if payload == "SlotCount" then
			refreshAllBaseSlots(sess)
		elseif payload == "SpeedLevel" then
			updateTreadmillLabels(sess)
		end
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
		syncPlayerState(sess)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "✨ " .. upgConfig.Name .. " amélioré au Niveau " .. (currentLvl + 1) .. " !", Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 125))

	elseif actionType == "EquipSword" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		if table.find(sess.Inventory, payload) then
			equipSwordOnCharacter(sess, payload)
		end

	elseif actionType == "ActivatePotion" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		local cost = 500
		if sess.Money < cost then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "Il faut $500 pour activer une Potion Boost (3 min) !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 95))
			return
		end
		sess.Money -= cost
		local now = os.clock()
		if payload == "Speed" then
			sess.SpeedBoostUntil = math.max(now, sess.SpeedBoostUntil) + 180
			applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "🧪 Potion x2 Vitesse activée (3 min) !", Color3.fromRGB(85, 225, 255))
		else
			sess.MoneyBoostUntil = math.max(now, sess.MoneyBoostUntil) + 180
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "🧪 Potion x2 Argent activée (3 min) !", Color3.fromRGB(95, 255, 120))
		end
		syncPlayerState(sess)
	end
end)

-- Boucle 1 seconde : Revenus $/s des épées écloses + Entraînement sur SON tapis personnel + Éclosion des Pierres
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local now = os.clock()
		if now >= NightEventCycleEnd then
			NightEventCycleEnd = now + 240
		end

		for _, slot in ipairs(StoneSpawns) do
			if not slot.CurrentModel and slot.RespawnAt and now >= slot.RespawnAt then
				slot.RespawnAt = nil
				spawnSwordStoneAt(slot)
			end
		end

		for _, sess in pairs(PlayerSessions) do
			local mps = getPlayerMoneyPerSec(sess)
			if mps > 0 then
				sess.Money += mps
			end

			-- Entraînement sur SON propre Tapis de Course personnel uniquement !
			if sess.Treadmill and sess.Treadmill.Belt then
				local char = sess.Player.Character
				local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
				local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
				if hrp and hum then
					local diff = hrp.Position - sess.Treadmill.Belt.Position
					if math.abs(diff.X) <= 5.5 and math.abs(diff.Z) <= 10.5 and math.abs(diff.Y) <= 6.5 then
						if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 then
							local gain = GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(sess.Upgrades.SpeedLevel)
							sess.TrainedSpeed += gain
							applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
							PopupEvent:FireClient(sess.Player, "Speed", "+" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(gain))
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- Compte à rebours des Pierres posées dans la base du joueur
			for _, slot in ipairs(sess.Slots) do
				if slot.State == "Forging" and slot.EndTime then
					local rem = math.ceil(slot.EndTime - now)
					if rem > 0 then
						slot.SubLabel.Text = "⏳ " .. GameConfig.FormatTime(rem)
					else
						slot.State = "Ready"
						refreshSlotVisuals(sess, slot)
					end
				end
			end

			syncPlayerState(sess)
		end
	end
end)

-- Boucle 60 FPS : Animation et IA des 10 Gardes
-- RÈGLE STRICTE : Les gardes N'ATTAQUENT QUE les joueurs qui portent une Pierre d'Épée (sess.CarryingStoneId ~= nil) !
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	for _, g in ipairs(Guardians) do
		local root = g.Model.PrimaryPart
		if not root then
			continue
		end

		g.AnimTime += dt

		local targetSession: PlayerSession? = nil
		local targetPos: Vector3? = nil
		local bestDist = 9999

		for _, sess in pairs(PlayerSessions) do
			-- Le Garde ignore totalement les joueurs qui n'ont PAS de Pierre d'Épée dans les mains !
			if sess.CarryingStoneId ~= nil then
				local char = sess.Player.Character
				local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
				if hrp then
					local pPos = hrp.Position
					if pPos.Z <= g.ZoneZMax + 6 and pPos.Z >= g.ZoneZMin - 6 and math.abs(pPos.X) <= CORRIDOR_WIDTH / 2 then
						local d = (pPos - root.Position).Magnitude
						if d < bestDist then
							bestDist = d
							targetSession = sess
							targetPos = pPos
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local currentPos = root.Position
		local nextPos: Vector3
		local lookTarget: Vector3
		local isChasing = false

		if targetSession and targetPos then
			isChasing = true
			if g.StatusLabel then
				g.StatusLabel.Text = "😡 VOLEUR : " .. targetSession.Player.DisplayName .. " !"
				g.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
			end

			-- Calcul de la vitesse physique du Garde comparée à la Vitesse du joueur :
			-- Si la Vitesse du joueur est inférieure à GuardianSpeedStat, le Garde est plus rapide que lui !
			local playerChar = targetSession.Player.Character
			local playerHum = if playerChar then playerChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			local playerWalkSpeed = if playerHum then playerHum.WalkSpeed else 16
			local playerStatSpeed = math.max(1, getPlayerTotalSpeed(targetSession))
			local guardStatSpeed = g.Tier.GuardianSpeedStat

			local speedRatio = math.clamp(guardStatSpeed / playerStatSpeed, 0.55, 1.65)
			local guardPhysicalSpeed = math.clamp(playerWalkSpeed * speedRatio * 1.12, 18, 190)

			local dir = Vector3.new(targetPos.X - currentPos.X, 0, targetPos.Z - currentPos.Z)
			if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				nextPos = currentPos + dir.Unit * guardPhysicalSpeed * dt
				lookTarget = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, currentPos.Y, targetPos.Z)
			else
				nextPos = currentPos
				lookTarget = currentPos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			if bestDist < 6.5 then
				clearCarriedStone(targetSession)
				NotificationEvent:FireClient(
					targetSession.Player,
					string.format(
						"💥 Rattrapé par %s (Vit: %s) ! Entraîne-toi sur ton Tapis de Course !",
						g.Tier.GuardianName,
						GameConfig.FormatNumber(g.Tier.GuardianSpeedStat)
					),
					Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
				)
				local hrp = if playerChar then playerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
				if hrp then
					hrp.CFrame = targetSession.SpawnCFrame
				end
			end
		else
			-- Patrouille tranquille au centre de sa Zone (n'attaque personne sans Pierre)
			if g.StatusLabel then
				g.StatusLabel.Text = "🛡️ Ignore les joueurs sans Pierre"
				g.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 255, 215)
			end
			local patrolSpeed = 24 + g.Tier.ZoneOrder * 2
			local nextX = currentPos.X + g.PatrolDir * patrolSpeed * dt
			local maxPatrolX = (CORRIDOR_WIDTH / 2) - 16
			if nextX > maxPatrolX then
				nextX = maxPatrolX
				g.PatrolDir = -1
			elseif nextX < -maxPatrolX then
				nextX = -maxPatrolX
				g.PatrolDir = 1
			end
			-- Revenir doucement vers le Z central de sa zone
			local nextZ = currentPos.Z + (g.HomePos.Z - currentPos.Z) * math.min(1, dt * 3)
			nextPos = Vector3.new(nextX, currentPos.Y, nextZ)
			lookTarget = nextPos + Vector3.new(g.PatrolDir, 0, 0)
		end

		local rootCF = CFrame.lookAt(nextPos, lookTarget)
		ModelBuilder.PositionAndAnimateGuardian(g.Model, g.Tier.GuardianScale, rootCF, g.AnimTime, isChasing)
	end
end)

local function refreshUI()
	local dailyOffline = math.max(1000, currentState.MoneyPerSec * 86400)
	offlineLabel.Text = string.format("Vous gagnez $%s/jour hors ligne ! 😈", GameConfig.FormatNumber(dailyOffline))

	if currentState.TreadmillLevel > 1 then
		speedValueLabel.Text = string.format("%s (+%s/pas)", GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.TotalSpeed), GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.TreadmillGain))
	else
		speedValueLabel.Text = GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.TotalSpeed)
	end
	moneyValueLabel.Text = "$" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.Money)

	if currentState.SlowMode then
		slowKnob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(41, 3)
		slowKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 50)
	else
		slowKnob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
		slowKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 240, 45)
	end

	local nm = math.floor(currentState.NightRemaining / 60)
	local ns = currentState.NightRemaining % 60
	nightText.Text = string.format("en %d minutes\n%d secondes", nm, ns)

	if currentState.PotionRemaining > 0 then
		potionTimerLabel.Text = GameConfig.FormatTime(currentState.PotionRemaining)
	else
		potionTimerLabel.Text = "Boosts"
	end

	for _, upgId in ipairs(upgOrder) do
		local upgInfo = GameConfig.Upgrades[upgId]
		local row = upgradeRows[upgId]
		local lvl = (currentState.Upgrades :: any)[upgId] or 1
		row.Label.Text = string.format("%s (Niv. %d/%d)\n%s", upgInfo.Name, lvl, upgInfo.MaxLevel, upgInfo.Description)
		if lvl >= upgInfo.MaxLevel then
			row.Btn.Text = "MAX"
			row.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 105, 120)
		else
			local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(upgId, lvl)
			row.Btn.Text = "$" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost)
			row.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = if currentState.Money >= cost
				then Color3.fromRGB(55, 215, 75)
				else Color3.fromRGB(165, 60, 60)
		end
	end

	for _, c in ipairs(indexList:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local allSwords = {}
	for _, sInfo in pairs(GameConfig.Swords) do
		table.insert(allSwords, sInfo)
	end
	table.sort(allSwords, function(a, b)
		return a.MoneyPerSec < b.MoneyPerSec
	end)
	for _, sInfo in ipairs(allSwords) do
		local rInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[sInfo.Rarity]
		local unlocked = currentState.Discovered[sInfo.Id] == true
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 54)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = if unlocked then Color3.fromRGB(36, 44, 62) else Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 32)
		row.Parent = indexList
		addCorner(row, 8)
		addStroke(row, if unlocked then rInfo.Color else Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85), 1.5, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border)

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -8)
		lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		lbl.TextColor3 = if unlocked then rInfo.Color else Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 145)
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		lbl.TextScaled = true
		lbl.Text = if unlocked
			then string.format("✅ [%s] %s  —  +$%s/s", rInfo.Name, sInfo.Name, GameConfig.FormatNumber(sInfo.MoneyPerSec))
			else string.format("🔒 [%s] ???  —  +$%s/s", rInfo.Name, GameConfig.FormatNumber(sInfo.MoneyPerSec))
		lbl.Parent = row
	end
	indexList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #allSwords * 62)

	for _, c in ipairs(invList:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local counts: { [string]: number } = {}
	for _, sId in ipairs(currentState.Inventory) do
		counts[sId] = (counts[sId] or 0) + 1
	end
	local unique = {}
	for sId, _ in pairs(counts) do
		table.insert(unique, sId)
	end
	table.sort(unique, function(a, b)
		return GameConfig.Swords[a].MoneyPerSec > GameConfig.Swords[b].MoneyPerSec
	end)
	for _, sId in ipairs(unique) do
		local sInfo = GameConfig.Swords[sId]
		local rInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[sInfo.Rarity]
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 58)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 42, 58)
		row.Parent = invList
		addCorner(row, 10)
		addStroke(row, rInfo.Color, 1.5, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border)

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.68, -10, 1, -8)
		lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		lbl.TextColor3 = rInfo.Color
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		lbl.TextScaled = true
		lbl.Text = string.format("[%s] %s (x%d)\n+$%s/s", rInfo.Name, sInfo.Name, counts[sId], GameConfig.FormatNumber(sInfo.MoneyPerSec))
		lbl.Parent = row

		local eqBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		eqBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0, 40)
		eqBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.70, 0, 0.5, -20)
		local isEq = (currentState.EquippedSwordId == sId)
		eqBtn.BackgroundColor3 = if isEq then Color3.fromRGB(55, 175, 255) else Color3.fromRGB(65, 210, 85)
		eqBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		eqBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		eqBtn.TextScaled = true
		eqBtn.Text = if isEq then "Équipée" else "Équiper"
		eqBtn.Parent = row
		addCorner(eqBtn, 8)
		eqBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			ActionEvent:FireServer("EquipSword", sId)
		end)
	end
	invList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #unique * 66)
end

			)
			tw:Play()
			tw.Completed:Wait()
			pop:Destroy()

local SUFFIXES = { "K", "M", "B", "T", "Qa", "Qi" }
function GameConfig.FormatNumber(n: number): string
	if n < 1000 then
		return tostring(math.floor(n))
	end
	local index = math.min(#SUFFIXES, math.floor(math.log10(n) / 3))
	local scaled = n / (10 ^ (index * 3))
	if scaled >= 100 then
		return string.format("%d%s", math.floor(scaled), SUFFIXES[index])
	else
		return string.format("%.1f%s", scaled, SUFFIXES[index]):gsub("%.0", "")
	end
end

function GameConfig.FormatTime(seconds: number): string
	seconds = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	if seconds < 60 then
		return string.format("%ds", seconds)
	elseif seconds < 3600 then
		local m = math.floor(seconds / 60)
		local s = seconds % 60
		if s == 0 then
			return string.format("%dm", m)
		end
		return string.format("%dm %ds", m, s)
	else
		local h = math.floor(seconds / 3600)
		local m = math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
		return string.format("%dh %dm", h, m)
	end
end

function GameConfig.StatSpeedToWalkSpeed(statSpeed: number): number
	if statSpeed <= 18 then
		return 16
	end
	local logVal = math.log10(statSpeed / 18 + 1)
	return math.clamp(16 + logVal * 16, 16, 155)
end

-- Tire une épée aléatoire ET génère un revenu d'argent $/s aléatoire en fonction de la zone et de la rareté !
function GameConfig.RollRandomSwordFromStone(stoneId: string, uidCounter: number): OwnedSwordItem
	for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
		if tier.Id == stoneId then
			local totalWeight = 0
			for _, weight in pairs(tier.DropTable) do
				totalWeight += weight
			end
			local roll = math.random() * totalWeight
			local cumulative = 0
			local chosenSwordId = "WoodenDagger"
			for swordId, weight in pairs(tier.DropTable) do
				cumulative += weight
				if roll <= cumulative then
					chosenSwordId = swordId
					break
				end
			end

			local template = GameConfig.Swords[chosenSwordId] or GameConfig.Swords.WoodenDagger
			local rarityInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[template.Rarity] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common

			-- Jet aléatoire entre MinBaseMoneyPerSec et MaxBaseMoneyPerSec * multiplicateur de rareté
			local randomFactor = tier.MinBaseMoneyPerSec + math.random() * (tier.MaxBaseMoneyPerSec - tier.MinBaseMoneyPerSec)
			local finalMoneyPerSec = math.max(5, math.floor(randomFactor * rarityInfo.StatMultiplier))
			local sellPrice = math.floor(finalMoneyPerSec * 18) -- Valeur de revente chez le Marchand d'Épées

			return {
				Uid = string.format("sword_%d_%d", uidCounter, math.random(1000, 9999)),
				SwordId = chosenSwordId,
				Name = template.Name,
				Rarity = template.Rarity,
				ZoneOrder = tier.ZoneOrder,
				MoneyPerSec = finalMoneyPerSec,
				SellPrice = sellPrice,
			}
		end
	end

	return {
		Uid = "sword_default_" .. tostring(uidCounter),
		SwordId = "WoodenDagger",
		Name = "Dague d'Entraînement",
		Rarity = "Common",
		ZoneOrder = 1,
		MoneyPerSec = 10,
		SellPrice = 180,
	}
end

return GameConfig
