--!strict
-- Générateur de modèles 3D :
-- - Pierres d'Épée, Épées 3D, Clôtures, Tapis de course personnel
-- - Gardiens articulés (en veille AFK dans un coin de leur zone tant qu'aucune pierre n'est volée)
-- - Stands de Marchands 3D (Marchand de Revente d'Épées & Boutique de Traînées / Sentiers)

local GameConfig = require(script.Parent.GameConfig)

local ModelBuilder = {}

local function createPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = if props.Anchored ~= nil then props.Anchored else true
	p.CanCollide = if props.CanCollide ~= nil then props.CanCollide else false
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	p.TopSurface = props.TopSurface or Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.Name then
		p.Name = props.Name
	end
	if props.Parent then
		p.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return p
end

local function weldParts(root: BasePart, part: BasePart)
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Part0 = root
	w.Part1 = part
	w.Parent = root
end

function ModelBuilder.ApplySurfaceTexture(part: BasePart, textureId: string, faces: { Enum.NormalId }, studsPerTile: number, transparency: number?, color: Color3?)
	for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
		local tex = Instance.new("Texture")
		tex.Texture = textureId
		tex.Face = face
		tex.StudsPerTileU = studsPerTile
		tex.StudsPerTileV = studsPerTile
		tex.Transparency = transparency or 0.65
		if color then
			tex.Color3 = color
		end
		tex.Parent = part
	end
end

function ModelBuilder.ApplyFloorVisuals(floorPart: BasePart, baseColor: Color3, material: Enum.Material?)
	floorPart.Color = baseColor
	floorPart.Material = material or Enum.Material.Plastic
	floorPart.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	ModelBuilder.ApplySurfaceTexture(
		floorPart,
		"rbxassetid://6372755229",
		{ Enum.NormalId.Top },
		16,
		0.78,
		Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	)
end

-- Crée une Pierre d'Épée cristalline
function ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier, cframe: CFrame, isCarried: boolean?): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = stoneTier.Name

	local anchored = not isCarried

	local core = createPart({
		Name = "PrimaryPart",
		Size = Vector3.new(4.4, 5.4, 4.4),
		Color = stoneTier.StoneColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Rock,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false, -- Permet au joueur de s'approcher et de la toucher / ramasser sans blocage !
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = core

	local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1.25, 1)
	mesh.Parent = core

	local ring = createPart({
		Name = "AuraRing",
		Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
		Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 6.2, 6.2),
		Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		Transparency = 0.25,
		CFrame = core.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	if not anchored then
		weldParts(core, ring)
	end

	local shardAngles = { 0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315 }
	for i, deg in ipairs(shardAngles) do
		local rad = math.rad(deg)
		local offset = CFrame.new(math.cos(rad) * 1.8, (i % 2 == 0 and 0.4 or -0.5), math.sin(rad) * 1.8)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(22), rad, math.rad(18))
		local shard = createPart({
			Name = "CrystalShard_" .. i,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.85, 3.0, 0.85),
			Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CFrame = core.CFrame * offset,
			Anchored = anchored,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = model,
		})
		if not anchored then
			weldParts(core, shard)
		end
	end

	local blade = createPart({
		Name = "SealedBlade",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.38, 4.4, 1.15),
		Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = core.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.8, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	local guard = createPart({
		Name = "CrossGuard",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.65, 0.45, 2.7),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 38, 50),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.3, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	local grip = createPart({
		Name = "Grip",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.42, 1.4, 0.45),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 60, 35),
		Material = Enum.Material.Wood,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.1, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	if not anchored then
		weldParts(core, blade)
		weldParts(core, guard)
		weldParts(core, grip)
	end

	local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(stoneTier.CrystalColor, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
	particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
	particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.2)
	particles.Rate = 16
	particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
	particles.LightEmission = 1
	particles.Parent = core

	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = stoneTier.CrystalColor
	light.Range = 15
	light.Brightness = 2.4
	light.Parent = core

	return model
end

function ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(swordId: string, cframe: CFrame, anchored: boolean): Model
	local info = GameConfig.Swords[swordId] or GameConfig.Swords.WoodenDagger
	local rarity = GameConfig.Rarities[info.Rarity] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common
	local scale = info.Scale or 1.0

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = info.Name

	local handle = createPart({
		Name = "Handle",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.34 * scale, 1.35 * scale, 0.38 * scale),
		Color = info.HandleColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe,
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})
	model.PrimaryPart = handle

	local guard = createPart({
		Name = "Guard",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.55 * scale, 0.42 * scale, 2.3 * scale),
		Color = rarity.Color,
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 0.72 * scale, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local bladeLength = 4.2 * scale
	local blade = createPart({
		Name = "Blade",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.24 * scale, bladeLength, 0.9 * scale),
		Color = info.BladeColor,
		Material = if rarity.Order >= 3 then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.Metal,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, 0.72 * scale + bladeLength / 2, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local coreGlow = createPart({
		Name = "CoreGlow",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.28 * scale, bladeLength * 0.88, 0.3 * scale),
		Color = info.GlowColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = blade.CFrame,
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local pommel = createPart({
		Name = "Pommel",
		Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
		Size = Vector3.new(0.62 * scale, 0.62 * scale, 0.62 * scale),
		Color = rarity.Color,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
		CFrame = cframe * CFrame.new(0, -0.78 * scale, 0),
		Anchored = anchored,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	if not anchored then
		weldParts(handle, guard)
		weldParts(handle, blade)
		weldParts(handle, coreGlow)
		weldParts(handle, pommel)
	end

	if rarity.Order >= 2 then
		local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(rarity.Color, info.GlowColor)
		particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.38 * scale),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.2)
		particles.Rate = 6 * rarity.Order
		particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5, 4)
		particles.LightEmission = 1
		particles.Parent = blade
	end

	return model
end

function ModelBuilder.CreateFenceRect(parent: Instance, center: Vector3, width: number, depth: number, color: Color3, leaveFrontGap: boolean?)
	local folder = Instance.new("Model")
	folder.Name = "Fence"
	folder.Parent = parent

	local halfW = width / 2
	local halfD = depth / 2

	local corners = {
		Vector3.new(-halfW, 2.0, -halfD),
		Vector3.new(halfW, 2.0, -halfD),
		Vector3.new(-halfW, 2.0, halfD),
		Vector3.new(halfW, 2.0, halfD),
	}
	for _, c in ipairs(corners) do
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(1.0, 4.0, 1.0),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + c),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
	end

	for _, yH in ipairs({ 1.2, 2.8 }) do
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.45, 0.45),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, yH, halfD)),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, depth),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-halfW, yH, 0)),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
		createPart({
			Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, depth),
			CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(halfW, yH, 0)),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
			TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
			CanCollide = true,
			Parent = folder,
		})
		if not leaveFrontGap then
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(width, 0.45, 0.45),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, yH, -halfD)),
				Color = color,
				Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
				TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
				CanCollide = true,
				Parent = folder,
			})
		else
			local segW = (width - 12) / 2
			if segW > 1 then
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(segW, 0.45, 0.45),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-halfW + segW / 2, yH, -halfD)),
					Color = color,
					Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
					TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
					CanCollide = true,
					Parent = folder,
				})
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(segW, 0.45, 0.45),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(halfW - segW / 2, yH, -halfD)),
					Color = color,
					Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
					TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth,
					CanCollide = true,
					Parent = folder,
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

function ModelBuilder.PositionAndAnimateGuardian(model: Model, scale: number, rootCF: CFrame, animTime: number, isMoving: boolean)
	local s = scale
	local swingAmp = if isMoving then math.rad(42) else 0
	local swing = if isMoving then math.sin(animTime * 10) * swingAmp else 0

	local torso = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if torso then
		torso.CFrame = rootCF
	end
	local emblem = model:FindFirstChild("ChestEmblem") :: BasePart?
	if emblem then
		emblem.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.3 * s, -0.85 * s) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45))
	end
	local belt = model:FindFirstChild("Belt") :: BasePart?
	if belt then
		belt.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -1.35 * s, 0)
	end
	local cape = model:FindFirstChild("Cape") :: BasePart?
	if cape then
		local capeWave = math.rad(12) + math.abs(swing) * 0.4
		cape.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.6 * s, 1.2 * s) * CFrame.Angles(capeWave, 0, 0)
	end
	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	if head then
		head.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 2.75 * s, 0)
		local visor = model:FindFirstChild("VisorGlow") :: BasePart?
		if visor then
			visor.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.15 * s, -0.95 * s)
		end
	end

	local leftArm = model:FindFirstChild("LeftArm") :: BasePart?
	if leftArm then
		leftArm.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(-2.15 * s, 1.1 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.2 * s, 0)
	end
	local rightArm = model:FindFirstChild("RightArm") :: BasePart?
	if rightArm then
		local rAngle = if isMoving then math.rad(35) - swing * 0.7 else 0
		rightArm.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(2.15 * s, 1.1 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(rAngle, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.2 * s, 0)
		local blade = model:FindFirstChild("GuardBlade") :: BasePart?
		if blade then
			blade.CFrame = rightArm.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -1.0 * s, -2.4 * s) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75), 0, 0)
		end
	end

	local leftLeg = model:FindFirstChild("LeftLeg") :: BasePart?
	if leftLeg then
		leftLeg.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(-0.85 * s, -1.6 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.6 * s, 0)
	end
	local rightLeg = model:FindFirstChild("RightLeg") :: BasePart?
	if rightLeg then
		rightLeg.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0.85 * s, -1.6 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.6 * s, 0)
	end

	local hornIdx = 0
	for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			if child.Name == "HelmetHorn" and head then
				hornIdx += 1
				local side = if hornIdx == 1 then -1 else 1
				child.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(side * 1.05 * s, 0.9 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-15), 0, math.rad(-side * 28))
			elseif child.Name == "Pauldron" then
				local side = if child.Position.X < rootCF.Position.X then -1 else 1
				child.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(side * 2.1 * s, 1.2 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-side * 15))
			end
		end
	end
end

local function createPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")

	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.Plastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	p.TopSurface = props.TopSurface or Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Name then
		p.Name = props.Name
	end
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.Shape then

	end
	if props.Parent then

	end
	return p

local RUNWAY_START_Z = 35

local HUB_WIDTH = 225

local HUB_CENTER = Vector3.new(0, 0, RUNWAY_START_Z + HUB_DEPTH / 2) -- Centre à Z = 110 (de Z=35 à Z=185)

-- Multiplicateurs de la Traînée équipée
local function getTrailMultipliers(session: PlayerSession): (number, number)
	if not session.EquippedTrailId then
		return 1.0, 1.0
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(GameConfig.Trails) do
		if t.Id == session.EquippedTrailId then
			return t.SpeedMultiplier, t.MoneyMultiplier
		end
	end
	return 1.0, 1.0
end

local function getPlayerTotalSpeed(session: PlayerSession): number
	local spd = 18 + session.TrainedSpeed
	local trailSpdMult, _ = getTrailMultipliers(session)
	spd *= trailSpdMult
	if os.clock() < session.SpeedBoostUntil then
		spd *= 2
	end
	return math.floor(spd)
end

local function getPlayerMoneyPerSec(session: PlayerSession): number
	local total = 0
	for _, slot in ipairs(session.Slots) do
		if slot.State == "Sword" and slot.SwordItem then
			total += slot.SwordItem.MoneyPerSec
		end
	end
	local _, trailMoneyMult = getTrailMultipliers(session)
	total *= trailMoneyMult
	if os.clock() < session.MoneyBoostUntil then
		total *= 2
	end
	return math.floor(total)
end

local function applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session: PlayerSession)
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then
		return
	end

	local statSpeed = getPlayerTotalSpeed(session)
	local walkSpeed = GameConfig.StatSpeedToWalkSpeed(statSpeed)

	if session.SlowMode then
		walkSpeed = 20
	end

	if session.CarryingStoneId then
		local slowFactor = 0.72
		for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
			if tier.Id == session.CarryingStoneId then
				slowFactor = tier.CarrySlowFactor
				break
			end
		end
		local bonus = (session.Upgrades.CarryStrength - 1) * 0.03
		walkSpeed = math.max(13, walkSpeed * math.clamp(slowFactor + bonus, 0.45, 0.95))
	end

	hum.WalkSpeed = walkSpeed
end

-- Attache visuellement la Traînée (Trail) au personnage du joueur
local function applyTrailOnCharacter(session: PlayerSession)
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not hrp then
		return
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
		if child.Name == "TrailAtt0" or child.Name == "TrailAtt1" or child.Name == "PlayerTrailEffect" then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	if not session.EquippedTrailId then
		return
	end

	local foundTrail: GameConfig.TrailInfo? = nil
	for _, t in ipairs(GameConfig.Trails) do
		if t.Id == session.EquippedTrailId then
			foundTrail = t
			break
		end
	end
	if not foundTrail then
		return
	end

	local att0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	att0.Name = "TrailAtt0"
	att0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	att0.Parent = hrp

	local att1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	att1.Name = "TrailAtt1"
	att1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.8, 0)
	att1.Parent = hrp

	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Name = "PlayerTrailEffect"
	trail.Attachment0 = att0
	trail.Attachment1 = att1
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(foundTrail.Color1, foundTrail.Color2)
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.05),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
	trail.Lifetime = 0.65
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.MinLength = 0.1
	trail.Parent = hrp
end

local function syncPlayerState(session: PlayerSession)
	local mps = getPlayerMoneyPerSec(session)
	local spd = getPlayerTotalSpeed(session)
	local trailSpdMult, trailMoneyMult = getTrailMultipliers(session)

	local leaderstats = session.Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if leaderstats then
		local mpsVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Money/s") :: StringValue?
		if mpsVal then
			mpsVal.Value = GameConfig.FormatNumber(mps)
		end
		local spdVal = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Vitesse") :: StringValue?
		if spdVal then
			spdVal.Value = GameConfig.FormatNumber(spd)
		end
	end

	StateUpdateEvent:FireClient(session.Player, {
		Money = session.Money,
		MoneyPerSec = mps,
		TotalSpeed = spd,
		TreadmillLevel = session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel,
		TreadmillGain = GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel),
		SlowMode = session.SlowMode,
		CarryingStoneId = session.CarryingStoneId,
		EquippedSwordUid = session.EquippedSwordUid,
		OwnedTrails = session.OwnedTrails,
		EquippedTrailId = session.EquippedTrailId,
		TrailSpeedMult = trailSpdMult,
		TrailMoneyMult = trailMoneyMult,
		Inventory = session.Inventory,
		Discovered = session.Discovered,
		Upgrades = session.Upgrades,
		NightRemaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(NightEventCycleEnd - os.clock())),
		PotionRemaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(math.max(session.SpeedBoostUntil, session.MoneyBoostUntil) - os.clock())),
	})
end

local function equipSwordItemOnCharacter(session: PlayerSession, item: GameConfig.OwnedSwordItem)
	session.EquippedSwordUid = item.Uid
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	if session.EquippedToolModel then
		session.EquippedToolModel:Destroy()
		session.EquippedToolModel = nil
	end

	local hand = (char:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) :: BasePart?
	if not hand then
		return
	end

	local swordModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(
		item.SwordId,
		hand.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0),
		false
	)
	swordModel.Name = "EquippedSwordVisual"
	swordModel.Parent = char

	if swordModel.PrimaryPart then
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = hand
		weld.Part1 = swordModel.PrimaryPart
		weld.Parent = swordModel.PrimaryPart
	end

	session.EquippedToolModel = swordModel
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

local function clearCarriedStone(session: PlayerSession)
	session.CarryingStoneId = nil
	if session.CarriedModel then
		session.CarriedModel:Destroy()
		session.CarriedModel = nil
	end
	applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

local function giveCarriedStone(session: PlayerSession, stoneTier: GameConfig.StoneTier)
	clearCarriedStone(session)
	local char = session.Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not hrp then
		return
	end

	session.CarryingStoneId = stoneTier.Id
	local stoneModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(stoneTier, hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.2, 0), true)
	stoneModel.Name = "CarriedSwordStone"
	stoneModel.Parent = char

	if stoneModel.PrimaryPart then
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = hrp
		weld.Part1 = stoneModel.PrimaryPart
		weld.Parent = stoneModel.PrimaryPart
	end

	session.CarriedModel = stoneModel
	applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
	syncPlayerState(session)
end

local function updateTreadmillLabels(session: PlayerSession)
	local tm = session.Treadmill
	if not tm then
		return
	end
	local lvl = session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel
	local gain = GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(lvl)
	local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost("SpeedLevel", lvl)
	tm.TitleLabel.Text = string.format("👟 Tapis de %s (Niv. %d)\n+%s Vitesse / pas", session.Player.DisplayName, lvl, GameConfig.FormatNumber(gain))
	if lvl >= GameConfig.Upgrades.SpeedLevel.MaxLevel then
		tm.BoardLabel.Text = string.format("Tapis Niveau MAX (%d)", lvl)
		tm.Prompt.ActionText = "Niveau MAX"
	else
		tm.BoardLabel.Text = string.format("Améliorer Tapis\nNiv. %d -> Niv. %d\n💵 $%s", lvl, lvl + 1, GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost))
		tm.Prompt.ActionText = "Améliorer ($" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost) .. ")"
	end
end

local function spawnOrMovePersonalTreadmill(session: PlayerSession, targetPos: Vector3, notifyPlayer: boolean)
	if targetPos.Z <= RUNWAY_START_Z + 10 then
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			"⛔ Impossible de poser ton Tapis dans les Zones de Pierres ! Pose-le dans le Hub !",
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
		)
		return
	end

	if session.Treadmill and session.Treadmill.Model then
		session.Treadmill.Model:Destroy()
		session.Treadmill = nil
	end

	local cleanPos = Vector3.new(
		math.clamp(targetPos.X, -HUB_WIDTH / 2 + 16, HUB_WIDTH / 2 - 16),
		0.6,
		math.clamp(targetPos.Z, RUNWAY_START_Z + 14, RUNWAY_START_Z + HUB_DEPTH - 14)
	)

	local lvl = session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel
	local gain = GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(lvl)
	local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost("SpeedLevel", lvl)

	local model, belt, prompt, titleLbl, boardLbl = ModelBuilder.CreatePersonalTreadmill(
		session.Player.DisplayName,
		cleanPos,
		lvl,
		gain,
		cost
	)
	model.Parent = MapFolder

	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(triggerPlr: Player)
		if triggerPlr ~= session.Player then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				triggerPlr,
				"⛔ Ce Tapis appartient à " .. session.Player.DisplayName .. " !",
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 95)
			)
			return
		end
		local curLvl = session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel
		if curLvl >= GameConfig.Upgrades.SpeedLevel.MaxLevel then
			return
		end
		local upgCost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost("SpeedLevel", curLvl)
		if session.Money < upgCost then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				session.Player,
				"Pas assez d'Argent ! Il faut $" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(upgCost),
				Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85)
			)
			return
		end
		session.Money -= upgCost
		session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel += 1
		updateTreadmillLabels(session)
		syncPlayerState(session)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			string.format("👟 Tapis amélioré au Niveau %d (+%s Vitesse/pas) !", session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel, GameConfig.FormatNumber(GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(session.Upgrades.SpeedLevel))),
			Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 130)
		)
	end)

	session.Treadmill = {
		Model = model,
		Belt = belt,
		Prompt = prompt,
		TitleLabel = titleLbl,
		BoardLabel = boardLbl,
	}

	if notifyPlayer then
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(
			session.Player,
			"👟 Ton Tapis de Course personnel a été déplacé ici !",
			Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 235)
		)
	end
end

local function giveTreadmillSpawnerTool(player: Player)
	local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack", 5)
	if not backpack then
		return
	end
	if backpack:FindFirstChild("Poser Tapis") or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Poser Tapis")) then
		return
	end

	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = "Poser Tapis"
	tool.RequiresHandle = true
	tool.CanBeDropped = false

	createPart({
		Name = "Handle",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 0.5, 2.0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 25),
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		Anchored = false,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = tool,
	})

	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local sess = PlayerSessions[player]
		if not sess then
			return
		end
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil

		end
	end)

	tool.Parent = backpack
end

local function refreshSlotVisuals(session: PlayerSession, slot: BaseSlot)
	local unlocked = slot.SlotIndex <= session.Upgrades.SlotCount
	if not unlocked then
		slot.PadPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85)
		slot.PadPart.Transparency = 0.5
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = false
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = false
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = "🔒 Verrouillé"
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 170, 180)
		slot.SubLabel.Text = "Boutique (+Emplacement)"
		return
	end

	slot.PadPart.Transparency = 0
	if slot.State == "Empty" then
		slot.PadPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 235, 65)
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = "Emplacement Libre"
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		slot.SubLabel.Text = "Rentre avec une Pierre !"
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = true
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ObjectText = "Emplacement #" .. slot.SlotIndex
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ActionText = "Poser la Pierre d'Épée"
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = false

	elseif slot.State == "Forging" then
		slot.PadPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 45)
		local rem = if slot.EndTime then math.max(0, math.ceil(slot.EndTime - os.clock())) else 0
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = "Éclosion en cours..."
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 65)
		slot.SubLabel.Text = "⏳ " .. GameConfig.FormatTime(rem)
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = false
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = false

	elseif slot.State == "Ready" then
		slot.PadPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = "Pierre\nPrête!"
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
		slot.SubLabel.Text = "Éclosion !\n[E] Ouvrir !"
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = true
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ObjectText = "Pierre Prête !"
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ActionText = "Éclosion !"
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = false

	elseif slot.State == "Sword" and slot.SwordItem then
		local rarity = GameConfig.Rarities[slot.SwordItem.Rarity] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common
		slot.PadPart.Color = rarity.Color
		slot.TitleLabel.Text = string.format("[%s] %s", rarity.Name, slot.SwordItem.Name)
		slot.TitleLabel.TextColor3 = rarity.Color
		slot.SubLabel.Text = string.format("+$%s / sec", GameConfig.FormatNumber(slot.SwordItem.MoneyPerSec))
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.Enabled = true
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ObjectText = slot.SwordItem.Name
		slot.PrimaryPrompt.ActionText = "Équiper dans la main"
		slot.RemovePrompt.Enabled = true
	end
end

local function refreshAllBaseSlots(session: PlayerSession)
	for _, slot in ipairs(session.Slots) do
		refreshSlotVisuals(session, slot)
	end
end

local function placeCarriedStoneOnSlot(session: PlayerSession, slot: BaseSlot): boolean
	if slot.SlotIndex > session.Upgrades.SlotCount or slot.State ~= "Empty" or not session.CarryingStoneId then
		return false
	end

	local stoneId = session.CarryingStoneId
	local foundTier: GameConfig.StoneTier? = nil
	for _, tier in ipairs(GameConfig.StoneTiers) do
		if tier.Id == stoneId then
			foundTier = tier
			break
		end
	end
	if not foundTier then
		return false
	end

	clearCarriedStone(session)

	local speedMult = 1 + (session.Upgrades.ForgeSpeed - 1) * 0.25
	local duration = math.max(4, math.ceil(foundTier.ForgeTime / speedMult))

	slot.State = "Forging"
	slot.StoneId = stoneId
	slot.EndTime = os.clock() + duration

	if slot.VisualModel then
		slot.VisualModel:Destroy()
	end
	local stoneModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(foundTier, slot.PadPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0), false)
	stoneModel.Parent = session.BaseModel
	slot.VisualModel = stoneModel

	refreshSlotVisuals(session, slot)
	NotificationEvent:FireClient(
		session.Player,
		string.format("🪨 %s déposée dans ta base ! Éclosion dans %s", foundTier.Name, GameConfig.FormatTime(duration)),
		foundTier.CrystalColor
	)
	return true
end

-- Éclosion : génère une épée aléatoire avec un revenu $/s aléatoire !
local function hatchStoneOnSlot(session: PlayerSession, slot: BaseSlot)
	if slot.State ~= "Ready" or not slot.StoneId then
		return
	end

	local forgedStoneId = slot.StoneId
	slot.StoneId = nil
	slot.EndTime = nil
	if slot.VisualModel then
		slot.VisualModel:Destroy()
		slot.VisualModel = nil
	end

	session.NextSwordUidCounter += 1
	local wonItem = GameConfig.RollRandomSwordFromStone(forgedStoneId, session.NextSwordUidCounter)
	local rarityInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[wonItem.Rarity] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common

	slot.State = "Sword"
	slot.SwordItem = wonItem

	local swordModel = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordModel(
		wonItem.SwordId,
		slot.PadPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(180)),
		true
	)
	swordModel.Parent = session.BaseModel
	slot.VisualModel = swordModel

	table.insert(session.Inventory, wonItem)
	session.Discovered[wonItem.SwordId] = true

	equipSwordItemOnCharacter(session, wonItem)
	refreshSlotVisuals(session, slot)
	syncPlayerState(session)

	SwordRevealEvent:FireClient(session.Player, {
		SwordId = wonItem.SwordId,
		Name = wonItem.Name,
		Rarity = rarityInfo.Name,
		RarityColor = rarityInfo.Color,
		MoneyPerSec = wonItem.MoneyPerSec,
		SellPrice = wonItem.SellPrice,
	})
end

local function tryGrabStone(plr: Player, slot: ActiveStoneSpawn)
	if not slot.CurrentModel then
		return
	end
	local sess = PlayerSessions[plr]
	if not sess then
		return
	end
	if sess.CarryingStoneId then
		return
	end

	slot.CurrentModel:Destroy()
	slot.CurrentModel = nil
	slot.RespawnAt = os.clock() + 8

	giveCarriedStone(sess, slot.Tier)
	NotificationEvent:FireClient(
		plr,
		string.format("⚠️ %s attrapée ! Le %s sort de son coin AFK, cours à ta Base !", slot.Tier.Name, slot.Tier.GuardianName),
		slot.Tier.CrystalColor
	)
end

local function spawnSwordStoneAt(slot: ActiveStoneSpawn)
	if slot.CurrentModel then
		slot.CurrentModel:Destroy()
		slot.CurrentModel = nil
	end

	local model = ModelBuilder.CreateSwordStoneModel(slot.Tier, CFrame.new(slot.SpawnPos), false)
	model.Parent = MapFolder
	slot.CurrentModel = model

	local root = model.PrimaryPart
	if not root then

	end

	bg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 62)

	bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bg.MaxDistance = 150

	local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	lbl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	lbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	lbl.TextColor3 = slot.Tier.CrystalColor
	lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	lbl.TextScaled = true
	lbl.Text = string.format(
		"%s ($%s-$%s/s)\n[E ou Touche] Voler (%s)",
		slot.Tier.Name,
		GameConfig.FormatNumber(slot.Tier.MinBaseMoneyPerSec),
		GameConfig.FormatNumber(slot.Tier.MaxBaseMoneyPerSec * 3),
		GameConfig.FormatTime(slot.Tier.ForgeTime)
	)
	lbl.Parent = bg

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")

	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = root

	click.MaxActivationDistance = 20
	click.Parent = root
	click.MouseClick:Connect(function(plr: Player)
		tryGrabStone(plr, slot)
	end)

	root.Touched:Connect(function(hit: BasePart)
		local char = hit.Parent
		local plr = if char then Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char) else nil
		if plr then
			tryGrabStone(plr, slot)
		end
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local chosenIndex = 1
	for i = 1, 4 do
		if not AssignedBases[i] then
			chosenIndex = i
			AssignedBases[i] = player
			break
		end
	end

	local baseSlot = BaseSlotsData[chosenIndex]
	baseSlot.OwnerNameLabel.Text = player.DisplayName
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, content = pcall(function()
			return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(player.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
		end)
		if ok and content then
			baseSlot.AvatarImage.Image = content
		end
	end)

	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local mpsVal = Instance.new("StringValue")
	mpsVal.Name = "Money/s"
	mpsVal.Value = "0"
	mpsVal.Parent = leaderstats

	local spdVal = Instance.new("StringValue")
	spdVal.Name = "Vitesse"
	spdVal.Value = "18"
	spdVal.Parent = leaderstats

	local session: PlayerSession = {
		Player = player,
		Money = 60,
		TrainedSpeed = 0,
		SlowMode = false,
		SpeedBoostUntil = 0,
		MoneyBoostUntil = 0,
		CarryingStoneId = nil,
		CarriedModel = nil,
		EquippedSwordUid = nil,
		EquippedToolModel = nil,
		OwnedTrails = {},
		EquippedTrailId = nil,
		Inventory = {},
		Discovered = {},
		Upgrades = {
			SpeedLevel = 1,
			CarryStrength = 1,
			ForgeSpeed = 1,
			SlotCount = 4,
		},
		BaseIndex = chosenIndex,
		BaseCenter = baseSlot.Center,
		BaseModel = baseSlot.Model,
		SpawnCFrame = baseSlot.SpawnCFrame,
		Slots = baseSlot.Slots,
		Treadmill = nil,
		NextSwordUidCounter = 0,
	}
	PlayerSessions[player] = session

	refreshAllBaseSlots(session)

	-- Tapis personnel posé par défaut près de sa base
	local defaultTreadmillPos = baseSlot.Center + Vector3.new(if baseSlot.Center.X < 0 then 36 else -36, 0, 0)
	spawnOrMovePersonalTreadmill(session, defaultTreadmillPos, false)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char: Model)
		task.wait(0.15)
		local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5) :: BasePart?
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = session.SpawnCFrame
		end
		session.CarryingStoneId = nil
		session.CarriedModel = nil
		if session.EquippedSwordUid then
			for _, item in ipairs(session.Inventory) do
				if item.Uid == session.EquippedSwordUid then
					equipSwordItemOnCharacter(session, item)
					break
				end
			end
		end
		applyTrailOnCharacter(session)
		giveTreadmillSpawnerTool(player)
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
		syncPlayerState(session)
	end)

	if player.Character then
		local hrp = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if hrp then
			hrp.CFrame = session.SpawnCFrame
		end
		applyTrailOnCharacter(session)
		giveTreadmillSpawnerTool(player)
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(session)
	end

	task.delay(0.5, function()
		syncPlayerState(session)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local sess = PlayerSessions[player]
	if sess then
		AssignedBases[sess.BaseIndex] = nil
		local baseSlot = BaseSlotsData[sess.BaseIndex]
		if baseSlot then
			baseSlot.OwnerNameLabel.Text = "Base Libre"
			baseSlot.AvatarImage.Image = ""
		end
		if sess.Treadmill and sess.Treadmill.Model then
			sess.Treadmill.Model:Destroy()
			sess.Treadmill = nil
		end
		for _, slot in ipairs(sess.Slots) do
			slot.State = "Empty"
			slot.StoneId = nil
			slot.EndTime = nil
			slot.SwordItem = nil
			if slot.VisualModel then
				slot.VisualModel:Destroy()
				slot.VisualModel = nil
			end
		end
		PlayerSessions[player] = nil
	end
end

-- Gestion de toutes les actions du joueur (Boutique, Revente d'épées, Achat/Équipement de Traînées)
ActionEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, actionType: string, payload: any)
	local sess = PlayerSessions[player]
	if not sess then
		return
	end

	if actionType == "ToggleSlowMode" then
		sess.SlowMode = not sess.SlowMode
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
		syncPlayerState(sess)

	elseif actionType == "SpawnTreadmill" then
		local char = player.Character
		local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
		if hrp then
			local targetPos = hrp.Position + hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 12
			spawnOrMovePersonalTreadmill(sess, targetPos, true)
		end

	elseif actionType == "BuyUpgrade" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		local upgConfig = GameConfig.Upgrades[payload]
		local currentLvl = (sess.Upgrades :: any)[payload]
		if not upgConfig or not currentLvl or currentLvl >= upgConfig.MaxLevel then
			return
		end
		local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(payload, currentLvl)
		if sess.Money < cost then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "Il te manque $" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost - sess.Money) .. " !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90))
			return
		end
		sess.Money -= cost
		;(sess.Upgrades :: any)[payload] = currentLvl + 1
		if payload == "SlotCount" then
			refreshAllBaseSlots(sess)
		elseif payload == "SpeedLevel" then
			updateTreadmillLabels(sess)
		end
		applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
		syncPlayerState(sess)
		NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "✨ " .. upgConfig.Name .. " Niveau " .. (currentLvl + 1) .. " !", Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 125))

	elseif actionType == "EquipSword" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		for _, item in ipairs(sess.Inventory) do
			if item.Uid == payload then
				equipSwordItemOnCharacter(sess, item)
				break
			end
		end

	elseif actionType == "SellSword" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		-- Vendre une épée spécifique de l'inventaire chez le Marchand d'Épées
		for idx, item in ipairs(sess.Inventory) do
			if item.Uid == payload then
				-- Si l'épée était posée sur un emplacement de base, libérer l'emplacement
				for _, slot in ipairs(sess.Slots) do
					if slot.State == "Sword" and slot.SwordItem and slot.SwordItem.Uid == payload then
						slot.State = "Empty"
						slot.SwordItem = nil
						if slot.VisualModel then
							slot.VisualModel:Destroy()
							slot.VisualModel = nil
						end
						refreshSlotVisuals(sess, slot)
					end
				end
				if sess.EquippedSwordUid == payload then
					sess.EquippedSwordUid = nil
					if sess.EquippedToolModel then
						sess.EquippedToolModel:Destroy()
						sess.EquippedToolModel = nil
					end
				end
				sess.Money += item.SellPrice
				table.remove(sess.Inventory, idx)
				syncPlayerState(sess)
				NotificationEvent:FireClient(
					player,
					string.format("💰 %s vendue pour +$%s !", item.Name, GameConfig.FormatNumber(item.SellPrice)),
					Color3.fromRGB(85, 255, 110)
				)
				break
			end
		end

	elseif actionType == "BuyOrEquipTrail" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		local foundTrail: GameConfig.TrailInfo? = nil
		for _, t in ipairs(GameConfig.Trails) do
			if t.Id == payload then
				foundTrail = t
				break
			end
		end
		if not foundTrail then
			return
		end

		if sess.OwnedTrails[foundTrail.Id] then
			sess.EquippedTrailId = foundTrail.Id
			applyTrailOnCharacter(sess)
			applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
			syncPlayerState(sess)
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "✨ Traînée équipée : " .. foundTrail.Name, foundTrail.Color1)
		else
			if sess.Money < foundTrail.Price then
				NotificationEvent:FireClient(
					player,
					"Pas assez d'Argent ! Il faut $" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(foundTrail.Price),
					Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
				)
				return
			end
			sess.Money -= foundTrail.Price
			sess.OwnedTrails[foundTrail.Id] = true
			sess.EquippedTrailId = foundTrail.Id
			applyTrailOnCharacter(sess)
			applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
			syncPlayerState(sess)
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(
				player,
				string.format("✨ %s achetée et équipée (x%.2f Vitesse & x%.2f Argent) !", foundTrail.Name, foundTrail.SpeedMultiplier, foundTrail.MoneyMultiplier),
				foundTrail.Color1
			)
		end

	elseif actionType == "ActivatePotion" and typeof(payload) == "string" then
		local cost = 500
		if sess.Money < cost then
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "Il faut $500 pour activer une Potion Boost (3 min) !", Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 95))
			return
		end
		sess.Money -= cost
		local now = os.clock()
		if payload == "Speed" then
			sess.SpeedBoostUntil = math.max(now, sess.SpeedBoostUntil) + 180
			applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "🧪 Potion x2 Vitesse activée (3 min) !", Color3.fromRGB(85, 225, 255))
		else
			sess.MoneyBoostUntil = math.max(now, sess.MoneyBoostUntil) + 180
			NotificationEvent:FireClient(player, "🧪 Potion x2 Argent activée (3 min) !", Color3.fromRGB(95, 255, 120))
		end
		syncPlayerState(sess)
	end
end)

-- Boucle 1 seconde
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local now = os.clock()
		if now >= NightEventCycleEnd then
			NightEventCycleEnd = now + 240
		end

		for _, slot in ipairs(StoneSpawns) do
			if not slot.CurrentModel and slot.RespawnAt and now >= slot.RespawnAt then
				slot.RespawnAt = nil
				spawnSwordStoneAt(slot)
			end
		end

		for _, sess in pairs(PlayerSessions) do
			local mps = getPlayerMoneyPerSec(sess)
			if mps > 0 then
				sess.Money += mps
			end

			if sess.Treadmill and sess.Treadmill.Belt then
				local char = sess.Player.Character
				local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
				local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
				if hrp and hum then
					local diff = hrp.Position - sess.Treadmill.Belt.Position
					if math.abs(diff.X) <= 5.5 and math.abs(diff.Z) <= 10.5 and math.abs(diff.Y) <= 6.5 then
						if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 then
							local baseGain = GameConfig.GetTreadmillGainPerTick(sess.Upgrades.SpeedLevel)
							local trailSpdMult, _ = getTrailMultipliers(sess)
							local finalGain = math.floor(baseGain * trailSpdMult)
							sess.TrainedSpeed += finalGain
							applyCharacterWalkSpeed(sess)
							PopupEvent:FireClient(sess.Player, "Speed", "+" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(finalGain))
						end
					end
				end
			end

			for _, slot in ipairs(sess.Slots) do
				if slot.State == "Forging" and slot.EndTime then
					local rem = math.ceil(slot.EndTime - now)
					if rem > 0 then
						slot.SubLabel.Text = "⏳ " .. GameConfig.FormatTime(rem)
					else
						slot.State = "Ready"
						refreshSlotVisuals(sess, slot)
					end
				end
			end

			syncPlayerState(sess)
		end
	end
end)

		if not root then
			continue
		end

		g.AnimTime += dt

		local targetSession: PlayerSession? = nil
		local targetPos: Vector3? = nil
		local bestDist = 9999

		for _, sess in pairs(PlayerSessions) do
			if sess.CarryingStoneId ~= nil then
				local char = sess.Player.Character
				local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
				if hrp then
					local pPos = hrp.Position
					if pPos.Z <= g.ZoneZMax + 6 and pPos.Z >= g.ZoneZMin - 6 and math.abs(pPos.X) <= CORRIDOR_WIDTH / 2 then
						local d = (pPos - root.Position).Magnitude
						if d < bestDist then
							bestDist = d
							targetSession = sess
							targetPos = pPos
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local currentPos = root.Position
		local nextPos: Vector3
		local lookTarget: Vector3
		local isMoving = false

		if targetSession and targetPos then
			-- Un joueur a volé une Pierre d'Épée -> Le Garde se réveille et fonce sur lui !
			isMoving = true
			if g.StatusLabel then
				g.StatusLabel.Text = "😡 POURSUITE : " .. targetSession.Player.DisplayName .. " !"
				g.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
			end

			local playerChar = targetSession.Player.Character
			local playerHum = if playerChar then playerChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			local playerWalkSpeed = if playerHum then playerHum.WalkSpeed else 16
			local playerStatSpeed = math.max(1, getPlayerTotalSpeed(targetSession))
			local guardStatSpeed = g.Tier.GuardianSpeedStat

			local speedRatio = math.clamp(guardStatSpeed / playerStatSpeed, 0.55, 1.65)
			local guardPhysicalSpeed = math.clamp(playerWalkSpeed * speedRatio * 1.15, 18, 195)

			local dir = Vector3.new(targetPos.X - currentPos.X, 0, targetPos.Z - currentPos.Z)
			if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				nextPos = currentPos + dir.Unit * guardPhysicalSpeed * dt
				lookTarget = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, currentPos.Y, targetPos.Z)
			else
				nextPos = currentPos
				lookTarget = currentPos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			if bestDist < 6.5 then
				clearCarriedStone(targetSession)
				NotificationEvent:FireClient(
					targetSession.Player,
					string.format(
						"💥 Rattrapé par %s (Vit: %s) !",
						g.Tier.GuardianName,
						GameConfig.FormatNumber(g.Tier.GuardianSpeedStat)
					),
					Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
				)
				local hrp = if playerChar then playerChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart? else nil
				if hrp then
					hrp.CFrame = targetSession.SpawnCFrame
				end
			end
		else
			-- Aucun voleur dans la zone : le Garde retourne dans son coin AFK et reste immobile !
			local cornerTarget = Vector3.new(g.CornerRestPos.X, currentPos.Y, g.CornerRestPos.Z)
			local toCorner = Vector3.new(cornerTarget.X - currentPos.X, 0, cornerTarget.Z - currentPos.Z)
			if toCorner.Magnitude > 1.2 then
				isMoving = true
				if g.StatusLabel then
					g.StatusLabel.Text = "🚶 Retourne dans son coin..."
					g.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 225, 240)
				end
				nextPos = currentPos + toCorner.Unit * math.min(toCorner.Magnitude, 36 * dt)
				lookTarget = Vector3.new(cornerTarget.X, currentPos.Y, cornerTarget.Z)
			else
				isMoving = false
				if g.StatusLabel then
					g.StatusLabel.Text = "💤 AFK (Immobile tant que tu ne voles rien)"
					g.StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 225, 255)
				end
				nextPos = cornerTarget
				-- Regarde vers le centre de sa zone depuis son coin
				lookTarget = Vector3.new(0, currentPos.Y, g.CornerRestPos.Z + 20)
			end
		end

		local rootCF = CFrame.lookAt(nextPos, lookTarget)
		ModelBuilder.PositionAndAnimateGuardian(g.Model, g.Tier.GuardianScale, rootCF, g.AnimTime, isMoving)
	end
end)

local function refreshUI()
	local dailyOffline = math.max(1000, currentState.MoneyPerSec * 86400)
	offlineLabel.Text = string.format("Vous gagnez $%s/jour hors ligne ! 😈", GameConfig.FormatNumber(dailyOffline))

	if currentState.TrailSpeedMult > 1.0 then
		speedValueLabel.Text = string.format("%s (x%.2f)", GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.TotalSpeed), currentState.TrailSpeedMult)
	else
		speedValueLabel.Text = GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.TotalSpeed)
	end
	moneyValueLabel.Text = "$" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(currentState.Money)

	if currentState.SlowMode then
		slowKnob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(41, 3)
		slowKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 50)
	else
		slowKnob.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3)
		slowKnob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(75, 240, 45)
	end

	local nm = math.floor(currentState.NightRemaining / 60)
	local ns = currentState.NightRemaining % 60
	nightText.Text = string.format("en %d minutes\n%d secondes", nm, ns)

	if currentState.PotionRemaining > 0 then
		potionTimerLabel.Text = GameConfig.FormatTime(currentState.PotionRemaining)
	else
		potionTimerLabel.Text = "Boosts"
	end

	-- Mise à jour de la Boutique
	for _, upgId in ipairs(upgOrder) do
		local upgInfo = GameConfig.Upgrades[upgId]
		local row = upgradeRows[upgId]
		local lvl = (currentState.Upgrades :: any)[upgId] or 1
		row.Label.Text = string.format("%s (Niv. %d/%d)\n%s", upgInfo.Name, lvl, upgInfo.MaxLevel, upgInfo.Description)
		if lvl >= upgInfo.MaxLevel then
			row.Btn.Text = "MAX"
			row.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 105, 120)
		else
			local cost = GameConfig.GetUpgradeCost(upgId, lvl)
			row.Btn.Text = "$" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(cost)
			row.Btn.BackgroundColor3 = if currentState.Money >= cost
				then Color3.fromRGB(55, 215, 75)
				else Color3.fromRGB(165, 60, 60)
		end
	end

	-- Mise à jour de la Boutique de Traînées
	for _, tInfo in ipairs(GameConfig.Trails) do
		local btn = trailRows[tInfo.Id]
		if btn then
			if currentState.EquippedTrailId == tInfo.Id then
				btn.Text = "Équipée"
				btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 175, 255)
			elseif currentState.OwnedTrails[tInfo.Id] then
				btn.Text = "Équiper"
				btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 210, 95)
			else
				btn.Text = "$" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(tInfo.Price)
				btn.BackgroundColor3 = if currentState.Money >= tInfo.Price
					then Color3.fromRGB(55, 215, 75)
					else Color3.fromRGB(165, 60, 60)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Mise à jour de l'Indice
	for _, c in ipairs(indexList:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, sInfo in pairs(GameConfig.Swords) do
		local rInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[sInfo.Rarity]
		local unlocked = currentState.Discovered[sInfo.Id] == true
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 50)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = if unlocked then Color3.fromRGB(36, 44, 62) else Color3.fromRGB(22, 24, 32)
		row.Parent = indexList
		addCorner(row, 8)
		addStroke(row, if unlocked then rInfo.Color else Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 85), 1.5, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border)

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -8)
		lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		lbl.TextColor3 = if unlocked then rInfo.Color else Color3.fromRGB(130, 135, 145)
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		lbl.TextScaled = true
		lbl.Text = if unlocked
			then string.format("✅ [%s] %s (Débloquée !)", rInfo.Name, sInfo.Name)
			else string.format("🔒 [%s] ??? (Éclos une Pierre pour découvrir)", rInfo.Name)
		lbl.Parent = row
	end

	-- Mise à jour de l'Inventaire & Revente d'Épées
	for _, c in ipairs(invList:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("Frame") then
			c:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local sortedInv = table.clone(currentState.Inventory)
	table.sort(sortedInv, function(a, b)
		return a.MoneyPerSec > b.MoneyPerSec
	end)

	for _, item in ipairs(sortedInv) do
		local rInfo = GameConfig.Rarities[item.Rarity] or GameConfig.Rarities.Common
		local row = Instance.new("Frame")
		row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 64)
		row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 42, 58)
		row.Parent = invList
		addCorner(row, 10)
		addStroke(row, rInfo.Color, 1.5, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border)

		local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.52, -10, 1, -8)
		lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 4)
		lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		lbl.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		lbl.TextColor3 = rInfo.Color
		lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		lbl.TextScaled = true
		lbl.Text = string.format("[%s] %s\n+$%s/s (Zone %d)", rInfo.Name, item.Name, GameConfig.FormatNumber(item.MoneyPerSec), item.ZoneOrder)
		lbl.Parent = row

		local eqBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		eqBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.21, 0, 0, 44)
		eqBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.53, 0, 0.5, -22)
		local isEq = (currentState.EquippedSwordUid == item.Uid)
		eqBtn.BackgroundColor3 = if isEq then Color3.fromRGB(55, 175, 255) else Color3.fromRGB(65, 200, 85)
		eqBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		eqBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		eqBtn.TextScaled = true
		eqBtn.Text = if isEq then "Équipée" else "Équiper"
		eqBtn.Parent = row
		addCorner(eqBtn, 8)
		eqBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			ActionEvent:FireServer("EquipSword", item.Uid)
		end)

		local sellBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
		sellBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.22, 0, 0, 44)
		sellBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.76, 0, 0.5, -22)
		sellBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 145, 35)
		sellBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
		sellBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		sellBtn.TextScaled = true
		sellBtn.Text = "Vendre\n$" .. GameConfig.FormatNumber(item.SellPrice)
		sellBtn.Parent = row
		addCorner(sellBtn, 8)
		sellBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			ActionEvent:FireServer("SellSword", item.Uid)
		end)
	end
	invList.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #sortedInv * 72)
end

	if processed then

		ActionEvent:FireServer("SpawnTreadmill")

-- Ouverture des fenêtres Marchands quand on interagit avec leurs stands dans le Hub !
OpenMerchantEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(merchantType: string)
	for _, m in ipairs(allModals) do
		m.Visible = false
	end
	if merchantType == "SellSwords" then
		invModal.Visible = true
	elseif merchantType == "TrailsShop" then
		trailsModal.Visible = true

StateUpdateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(newState)
	currentState = newState
	refreshUI()
end)

NotificationEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(msg: string, color: Color3)
	showNotification(msg, color)
end)

SwordRevealEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	revealStroke.Color = data.RarityColor
	revealName.Text = string.format("[%s]\n%s", data.Rarity, data.Name)
	revealName.TextColor3 = data.RarityColor
	revealStats.Text = string.format(
		"💵 Revenu aléatoire : +$%s / sec\n💰 Valeur revente : $%s",
		GameConfig.FormatNumber(data.MoneyPerSec),
		GameConfig.FormatNumber(data.SellPrice or 0)
	)
	revealCard.Visible = true
end)

PopupEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(_popupType: string, textValue: string)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		task.delay((i - 1) * 0.12, function()
			local pop = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			pop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 44)
			local rx = math.random(-140, 140)
			local ry = math.random(-70, 40)
			pop.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, rx - 85, 0.45, ry)
			pop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			pop.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
			pop.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 225)
			pop.TextScaled = true
			pop.Text = "👟 " .. textValue
			pop.Parent = screenGui
			addStroke(pop, Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 2.5)

			local tw = TweenService:Create(
				pop,
				TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{ Position = pop.Position - UDim2.fromOffset(0, 65), TextTransparency = 1 }
			)
			tw:Play()
			tw.Completed:Wait()
			pop:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end)

Voici tout ce qui a été corrigé et ajouté :

---

### 1. 🪨 Ramassage des Pierres d'Épée garanti à 100%
*(Pourquoi ça bloquait avant : les cristaux autour de la pierre bloquaient la ligne de vue de la caméra pour la touche `E`).*
Dans [init.server.luau](file:///C:/Users/Adam/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/steal-a-sword/src/server/init.server.luau) et [ModelBuilder.luau](file:///C:/Users/Adam/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/steal-a-sword/src/shared/ModelBuilder.luau), tu as maintenant **3 façons automatiques** d'attraper une Pierre d'Épée :
1. **Simplement marcher dessus / la toucher** (elle saute automatiquement dans tes mains si tu as les mains libres !).
2. **Appuyer sur `E`** (`RequiresLineOfSight = false` activé pour que le bouton `E` s'affiche toujours, même à travers les cristaux).
3. **Cliquer dessus à la souris** (`ClickDetector`).

---

### 2. 💤 Les Gardes sont AFK dans un coin de leur Zone
Dans [init.server.luau](file:///C:/Users/Adam/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/steal-a-sword/src/server/init.server.luau) :
- Chaque Garde reste **immobile (AFK)** dans un coin au fond de sa zone (`💤 AFK (Immobile tant que tu ne voles rien)`).
- Dès l'instant où tu attrapes une Pierre d'Épée dans sa zone, il se réveille (`😡 POURSUITE`) et court après toi ! Si tu sors de la zone, il retourne tranquillement dans son coin et se remet AFK.

---

### 3. 🎲 Épées aléatoires avec Revenu (`$/s`) aléatoire selon la Zone
Dans [GameConfig.luau](file:///C:/Users/Adam/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/steal-a-sword/src/shared/GameConfig.luau) :
- Chaque Pierre d'Épée tire une épée aléatoire de sa zone **ET** tire un montant d'argent par seconde **aléatoire** dans une fourchette propre à la zone et multipliée par la rareté :
  - *Zone 1* : entre **`$8/s` et `$80/s`**
  - *Zone 2* : entre **`$55/s` et `$600/s`**
  - *Zone 3* : entre **`$380/s` et `$4.3K/s`**
  - ... jusqu'à la *Zone 10* qui tire des épées entre **`$1.5B/s` et `$55B/s`** !

---

### 4. 🏪 Hub plus compact + Les 2 Nouveaux Marchands
Dans [init.server.luau](file:///C:/Users/Adam/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/steal-a-sword/src/server/init.server.luau) et [init.client.luau](file:///C:/Users/Adam/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/steal-a-sword/src/client/init.client.luau) :
- La zone des bases (Hub) a été **réduite** (`225 x 150` au lieu de `340 x 230`) pour que tout soit plus proche et vivant.
- Juste devant l'entrée de l'allée des zones, tu trouveras **2 Stands de Marchands avec PNJ** :
  1. **💰 Acheteur d'Épées (à gauche)** : Approche-toi et appuie sur `E` (ou ouvre ton menu `⚔️` à droite) pour **revendre n'importe quelle épée de ton inventaire** contre du Cash immédiat (`$`).
  2. **✨ Boutique de Sentiers / Traînées (à droite)** : Approche-toi et appuie sur `E` (ou clique sur le petit `+` jaune à côté de la chaussure de vitesse) pour acheter des **Traînées lumineuses** qui s'attachent à ton personnage :
     - *Sentier du Vent* (`$500` $\rightarrow$ `x1.15 Vitesse` | `x1.10 Argent`)
     - *Sentier d'Émeraude* (`$5K` $\rightarrow$ `x1.30 Vitesse` | `x1.25 Argent`)
     - *Sentier de Flammes* (`$75K` $\rightarrow$ `x1.50 Vitesse` | `x1.45 Argent`)
     - *Sentier Glacial* (`$1.2M` $\rightarrow$ `x1.75 Vitesse` | `x1.70 Argent`)
     - *Sentier d'Améthyste* (`$25M` $\rightarrow$ `x2.10 Vitesse` | `x2.00 Argent`)

--!strict
-- Générateur de modèles 3D :
-- - Vrais personnages Roblox (Humanoid + Mesh de Tête + Visage + Chapeau/Armure) pour les Marchands et les Gardes
-- - Décorations thématiques par Zone (Cactus dans le désert, Sapins enneigés, Cristaux, Colonnes, etc.)
-- - Pierres d'Épée, Épées 3D, Clôtures, Tapis de course personnel

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local GameConfig = require(script.Parent.GameConfig)

local ModelBuilder = {}

local function createPart(props: { [string]: any }): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Anchored = if props.Anchored ~= nil then props.Anchored else true
	p.CanCollide = if props.CanCollide ~= nil then props.CanCollide else false
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	p.CFrame = props.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	p.TopSurface = props.TopSurface or Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	if props.Transparency then
		p.Transparency = props.Transparency
	end
	if props.Name then
		p.Name = props.Name
	end
	if props.Parent then
		p.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return p
end

local function weldParts(root: BasePart, part: BasePart)
	local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	w.Part0 = root
	w.Part1 = part
	w.Parent = root
end

function ModelBuilder.ApplySurfaceTexture(part: BasePart, textureId: string, faces: { Enum.NormalId }, studsPerTile: number, transparency: number?, color: Color3?)
	for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
		local tex = Instance.new("Texture")
		tex.Texture = textureId
		tex.Face = face
		tex.StudsPerTileU = studsPerTile
		tex.StudsPerTileV = studsPerTile
		tex.Transparency = transparency or 0.65
		if color then
			tex.Color3 = color
		end
		tex.Parent = part
	end
end

function ModelBuilder.ApplyFloorVisuals(floorPart: BasePart, baseColor: Color3, material: Enum.Material?)
	floorPart.Color = baseColor
	floorPart.Material = material or Enum.Material.Plastic
	floorPart.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Studs
	ModelBuilder.ApplySurfaceTexture(
		floorPart,
		"rbxassetid://6372755229",
		{ Enum.NormalId.Top },
		16,
		0.78,
		Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. DÉCORATIONS THÉMATIQUES PAR ZONE (LÉGÈRES, ESTHÉTIQUES, SUR LES BORDS)
-- ============================================================================
function ModelBuilder.CreateZoneDecorations(parent: Instance, zoneOrder: number, zoneCenter: Vector3, zLength: number, corridorWidth: number)
	local decoFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	decoFolder.Name = "ZoneDecor_" .. zoneOrder
	decoFolder.Parent = parent

	-- 4 emplacements de décor sur les côtés de la zone (pour ne jamais gêner la course au milieu)
	local sideX = (corridorWidth / 2) - 10
	local zOff = zLength * 0.27
	local spots = {
		zoneCenter + Vector3.new(-sideX, 0, zOff),
		zoneCenter + Vector3.new(sideX, 0, zOff),
		zoneCenter + Vector3.new(-sideX, 0, -zOff),
		zoneCenter + Vector3.new(sideX, 0, -zOff),
	}

	for i, pos in ipairs(spots) do
		if zoneOrder == 1 then
			-- Zone 1 (Prairie) : Arbres ronds et buissons fleuris
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 8, 2.2),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(125, 85, 50),
				Material = Enum.Material.Wood,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
				Size = Vector3.new(9, 9, 9),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 9.5, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(65, 195, 55),
				Material = Enum.Material.Grass,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})

		elseif zoneOrder == 2 then
			-- Zone 2 (Vallée Rocheuse) : Rochers anciens et piliers de pierre
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(6, 5, 5),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(i * 40), math.rad(8)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(115, 120, 130),
				Material = Enum.Material.Rock,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(3.5, 8, 3.5),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(2, 4, 1.5)) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-10), 0, 0),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 100, 110),
				Material = Enum.Material.Slate,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})

		elseif zoneOrder == 3 then
			-- Zone 3 (Désert Doré) : Vrais Cactus à bras !
			local trunk = createPart({
				Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
				Size = Vector3.new(10, 2.4, 2.4),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 165, 65),
				Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
				Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 165, 65),
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			-- Bras gauche et droit du cactus
			for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
				local armY = if side == -1 then 5.2 else 6.4
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 1.5, 1.5),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(side * 1.6, armY, 0)),
					Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 165, 65),
					Parent = decoFolder,
				})
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 3.2, 1.5),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(side * 2.4, armY + 1.4, 0)),
					Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 165, 65),
					Parent = decoFolder,
				})
			end
			local _ = trunk

		elseif zoneOrder == 4 then
			-- Zone 4 (Jungle d'Émeraude) : Palmiers tropicaux et cristaux d'émeraude
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(2.0, 12, 2.0),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(i % 2 == 0 and 6 or -6)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(115, 75, 40),
				Material = Enum.Material.Wood,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			for a = 1, 4 do
				local ang = math.rad(a * 90)
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 0.5, 6.5),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * 2.8, 11.8, math.sin(ang) * 2.8))
						* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-20), ang, 0),
					Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 205, 85),
					Material = Enum.Material.Grass,
					Parent = decoFolder,
				})
			end

		elseif zoneOrder == 5 then
			-- Zone 5 (Terres Gelées) : Sapins enneigés et pics de glace
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(2, 5, 2),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 65, 45),
				Material = Enum.Material.Wood,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(7, 5, 7),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 6.5, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 245, 255),
				Material = Enum.Material.Snow,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(4.5, 4.5, 4.5),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 10.5, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 250, 255),
				Material = Enum.Material.Ice,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})

		elseif zoneOrder == 6 then
			-- Zone 6 (Canyon d'Améthyste) : Grappes de Cristaux géants
			for c = 1, 3 do
				createPart({
					Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 7 + c * 2, 1.8),
					CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new((c - 2) * 1.6, 3.5 + c, 0))
						* CFrame.Angles(math.rad((c - 2) * 15), math.rad(c * 30), math.rad((c - 2) * 12)),
					Color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 85, 255),
					Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
					Parent = decoFolder,
				})
			end

		elseif zoneOrder == 7 then
			-- Zone 7 (Terres de Lave) : Piliers de basalte et bassins de magma
			createPart({
				Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
				Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 7, 7),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 20),
				Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(3.5, 9, 3.5),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 25, 25),
				Material = Enum.Material.Basalt,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})

		elseif zoneOrder == 8 then
			-- Zone 8 (Royaume des Ténèbres) : Obélisques noirs runiques
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 14, 3.2),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(25, 18, 38),
				Material = Enum.Material.Slate,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
				Size = Vector3.new(2.8, 2.8, 2.8),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 15.8, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 35, 95),
				Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})

		elseif zoneOrder == 9 then
			-- Zone 9 (Nébuleuse Stellaire) : Planètes flottantes à anneaux
			local planet = createPart({
				Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
				Size = Vector3.new(5.5, 5.5, 5.5),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 9, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 130, 255),
				Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
				Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 10, 10),
				CFrame = planet.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(25), 0, math.rad(70)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(185, 220, 255),
				Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
				Transparency = 0.2,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})

		elseif zoneOrder == 10 then
			-- Zone 10 (Sanctuaire Divin) : Colonnes dorées antiques
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(4.2, 1.5, 4.2),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.75, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 240, 225),
				Material = Enum.Material.Marble,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
				Size = Vector3.new(13, 3.0, 3.0),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 7.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(250, 248, 235),
				Material = Enum.Material.Marble,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
			createPart({
				Size = Vector3.new(4.4, 1.6, 4.4),
				CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 14.5, 0)),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 65),
				Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
				Parent = decoFolder,
			})
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- 2. VRAI PERSONNAGE ROBLOX (HUMANOID + MESH TÊTE + VISAGE + VÊTEMENTS/CHAPEAU)
-- ============================================================================
function ModelBuilder.CreateRobloxCharacterNPC(
	name: string,
	rootCF: CFrame,
	scale: number,
	skinColor: Color3,
	torsoColor: Color3,
	legsColor: Color3,
	hatType: "Merchant" | "Wizard" | "Knight",
	accentColor: Color3
): Model
	local s = scale
	local npc = Instance.new("Model")
	npc.Name = name

	local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	hum.Parent = npc

	-- Torse Roblox avec biseaux doux
	local torso = createPart({
		Name = "HumanoidRootPart",
		Size = Vector3.new(2.0 * s, 2.0 * s, 1.0 * s),
		Color = torsoColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CFrame = rootCF,
		Anchored = true,
		CanCollide = true,
		Parent = npc,
	})
	npc.PrimaryPart = torso

	local torsoMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	torsoMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Brick
	torsoMesh.Bevel = 0.08 * s
	torsoMesh.Parent = torso

	-- Col / Foulard / Plastron décoratif
	createPart({
		Name = "Collar",
		Size = Vector3.new(2.1 * s, 0.45 * s, 1.1 * s),
		Color = accentColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Fabric,
		CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.8 * s, 0),
		Parent = npc,
	})

	-- Ceinture avec boucle dorée
	createPart({
		Name = "Belt",
		Size = Vector3.new(2.05 * s, 0.32 * s, 1.05 * s),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 35, 25),
		Material = Enum.Material.Leather,
		CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.85 * s, 0),
		Parent = npc,
	})
	createPart({
		Name = "BeltBuckle",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.45 * s, 0.38 * s, 0.15 * s),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 55),
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.85 * s, -0.52 * s),
		Parent = npc,
	})

	-- Tête cylindrique authentique Roblox + Visage souriant !
	local head = createPart({
		Name = "Head",
		Size = Vector3.new(2.0 * s, 1.0 * s, 1.0 * s),
		Color = skinColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 1.5 * s, 0),
		Parent = npc,
	})
	local headMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	headMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Head
	headMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1.25, 1.25, 1.25)
	headMesh.Parent = head

	local face = Instance.new("Decal")
	face.Name = "face"
	face.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	face.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/face.png"
	face.Parent = head

	-- Bras et Jambes avec biseaux Roblox
	local leftArm = createPart({
		Name = "LeftArm",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.0 * s, 2.0 * s, 1.0 * s),
		Color = torsoColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(-1.5 * s, 0, 0),
		Parent = npc,
	})
	-- Main gauche couleur peau
	createPart({
		Name = "LeftHand",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.95 * s, 0.45 * s, 0.95 * s),
		Color = skinColor,
		CFrame = leftArm.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.8 * s, 0),
		Parent = npc,
	})

	local rightArm = createPart({
		Name = "RightArm",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.0 * s, 2.0 * s, 1.0 * s),
		Color = torsoColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(1.5 * s, 0, 0),
		Parent = npc,
	})
	createPart({
		Name = "RightHand",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.95 * s, 0.45 * s, 0.95 * s),
		Color = skinColor,
		CFrame = rightArm.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.8 * s, 0),
		Parent = npc,
	})

	createPart({
		Name = "LeftLeg",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.0 * s, 2.0 * s, 1.0 * s),
		Color = legsColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(-0.5 * s, -2.0 * s, 0),
		Parent = npc,
	})

	createPart({
		Name = "RightLeg",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.0 * s, 2.0 * s, 1.0 * s),
		Color = legsColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0.5 * s, -2.0 * s, 0),
		Parent = npc,
	})

	-- Chapeau / Coiffe selon le rôle du PNJ
	if hatType == "Merchant" then
		-- Haut-de-forme / Chapeau de riche Marchand doré avec ruban
		createPart({
			Name = "HatBrim",
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.2 * s, 2.2 * s, 2.2 * s),
			CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.55 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 40),
			Parent = npc,
		})
		createPart({
			Name = "HatTop",
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			Size = Vector3.new(1.2 * s, 1.45 * s, 1.45 * s),
			CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.15 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 40),
			Parent = npc,
		})
		createPart({
			Name = "HatBand",
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.3 * s, 1.5 * s, 1.5 * s),
			CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.78 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
			Color = accentColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			Parent = npc,
		})
	elseif hatType == "Wizard" then
		-- Chapeau mystique de Maître des Sentiers / Traînées
		createPart({
			Name = "HatBrim",
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.18 * s, 2.5 * s, 2.5 * s),
			CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.55 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 65, 145),
			Parent = npc,
		})
		createPart({
			Name = "WizardCone",
			Size = Vector3.new(1.3 * s, 1.8 * s, 1.3 * s),
			CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.35 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-10), math.rad(45), 0),
			Color = accentColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
			Parent = npc,
		})
	end

	return npc
end

function ModelBuilder.PositionAndAnimateGuardian(model: Model, baseScale: number, rootCF: CFrame, animTime: number, isMoving: boolean)
	local s = baseScale * 1.35
	local swingAmp = if isMoving then math.rad(42) else 0
	local swing = if isMoving then math.sin(animTime * 10) * swingAmp else 0

	local torso = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if torso then
		torso.CFrame = rootCF
	end
	local collar = model:FindFirstChild("Collar") :: BasePart?
	if collar then
		collar.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 0.8 * s, 0)
	end
	local belt = model:FindFirstChild("Belt") :: BasePart?
	if belt then
		belt.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.85 * s, 0)
	end
	local buckle = model:FindFirstChild("BeltBuckle") :: BasePart?
	if buckle then
		buckle.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.85 * s, -0.52 * s)
	end
	local cape = model:FindFirstChild("Cape") :: BasePart?
	if cape then
		local capeWave = math.rad(12) + math.abs(swing) * 0.4
		cape.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, -0.45 * s, 0.65 * s) * CFrame.Angles(capeWave, 0, 0)
	end
	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	if head then
		head.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0, 1.5 * s, 0)
		local hTop = model:FindFirstChild("HelmetTop") :: BasePart?
		if hTop then
			hTop.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.52 * s, 0)
		end
		local visor = model:FindFirstChild("VisorGlow") :: BasePart?
		if visor then
			visor.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.12 * s, -0.58 * s)
		end
	end

	local leftArm = model:FindFirstChild("LeftArm") :: BasePart?
	if leftArm then
		leftArm.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(-1.5 * s, 0.7 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.7 * s, 0)
		local lHand = model:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") :: BasePart?
		if lHand then
			lHand.CFrame = leftArm.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.8 * s, 0)
		end
	end

	local rightArm = model:FindFirstChild("RightArm") :: BasePart?
	if rightArm then
		local rAngle = if isMoving then math.rad(35) - swing * 0.7 else 0
		rightArm.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(1.5 * s, 0.7 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(rAngle, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -0.7 * s, 0)
		local rHand = model:FindFirstChild("RightHand") :: BasePart?
		if rHand then
			rHand.CFrame = rightArm.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.8 * s, 0)
		end
		local blade = model:FindFirstChild("GuardBlade") :: BasePart?
		if blade then
			blade.CFrame = rightArm.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.8 * s, -1.8 * s) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75), 0, 0)
		end
	end

	local leftLeg = model:FindFirstChild("LeftLeg") :: BasePart?
	if leftLeg then
		leftLeg.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(-0.5 * s, -1.0 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.0 * s, 0)
	end
	local rightLeg = model:FindFirstChild("RightLeg") :: BasePart?
	if rightLeg then
		rightLeg.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(0.5 * s, -1.0 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(swing, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, -1.0 * s, 0)
	end

	local hornIdx = 0
	local pauldronIdx = 0
	for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			if child.Name == "HelmetHorn" and head then
				hornIdx += 1
				local side = if hornIdx == 1 then -1 else 1
				child.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(side * 0.72 * s, 0.65 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-12), 0, math.rad(-side * 26))
			elseif child.Name == "Pauldron" then
				pauldronIdx += 1
				local side = if pauldronIdx == 1 then -1 else 1
				child.CFrame = rootCF * CFrame.new(side * 1.55 * s, 0.85 * s, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-side * 12))
			end
		end
	end
end
